Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Posizione : Data Analyst

Sede : San Vittore Olona – Milano

Tipo di Impiego : Tempo pieno

Settore / Divisione : IT

RAL: Da definire

Livello : Livello intermedio (5-8 anni)

Tipo di Contratto: Tempo Indeterminato

Riporto : Global IT Manager / Data Lead

Area Operativa: Data & Analytics







Panoramica

Chematek è in forte espansione nella propria infrastruttura dati: stiamo costruendo un moderno data stack su Snowflake e Azure, integrando fonti ERP, CRM e operative provenienti da più paesi. Cerchiamo un Data Analyst con solide basi su data warehousing e una concreta voglia di crescere verso ML e AI applicata al business.




L’azienda

Chematek è un distributore di servizi tecnici, integrati e industriali, focalizzato sui settori della chimica fine, della petrolchimica, dell’ingegneria, approvvigionamento e costruzione (EPC) e dei lubrificanti. Opera attraverso 9 centri geografici ben integrati, con sede centrale nel Nord Italia.

Chematek è un’azienda a proprietà privata, attiva da oltre 40 anni. La società ha la missione di sviluppare i mercati e commercializzare prodotti differenziati e di eccellenza nei propri settori di riferimento, garantendo al contempo un servizio e una consegna eccellenti, solidi e affidabili alla propria ampia clientela globale.




Descrizione del ruolo

La risorsa lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Data Lead e con i partner di implementazione, partecipando attivamente alla costruzione e all’evoluzione della piattaforma dati aziendale.




Mansioni e responsabilità

Progettare e mantenere modelli dbt su Snowflake in collaborazione con il Data Lead
Costruire e ottimizzare pipeline ADF per l’ingestion da Business Central, HubSpot, Xero e altri sistemi operativi
Sviluppare report e dashboard su Power BI per le divisioni aziendali
Applicare modelli ML su dati aziendali per supportare analisi predittive e ottimizzazione operativa
Garantire qualità, documentazione e governance dei dati (GDPR); collaborare con i partner IT esterni nelle fasi di knowledge transfer







Requisiti del candidato

5–8 anni di esperienza in ruoli analitici (data analyst, BI developer, data engineer)
Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica o equivalente
Snowflake – modellazione, query optimization, cost monitoring, RBAC di base
SQL avanzato – window functions, CTE, ottimizzazione query su larga scala
Azure – Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2, ambienti cloud-native
dbt (data build tool) – modelli, tests, documentazione, lineage
Python – pandas, numpy, scripting di automazione e data prep
Power BI o Tableau (almeno uno a livello operativo; conoscenza dell’altro apprezzata)
Data modeling – star schema, dimensioni SCD, data vault di base
Plus apprezzati: ML applicato (scikit-learn), Azure ML / Azure AI Services, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Italiano ed inglese fluente scritto e parlato (ambiente internazionale)
Disponibilità a lavorare in full presence – San Vittore Olona, Milano

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are a rapidly growing pan-European digital wealth manager, serving over 167,000 active investors with more than £5.5 billion invested on our platform. We began in Milan in 2011 with the purpose to help more people improve their financial well-being by making personal investing simple and accessible through technology. Fast forward to today, and we are recognised as one of the most innovative fintechs, headquartered in the heart of London.

With a team of 220+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we are proudly backed and funded by major partners including Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures, and Allianz.

Our vision

Our vision is to combine passion, expertise, and technology to provide best-in-class investment solutions and advice that protects and grows client wealth over time.

Our Core Values:

We've built our business on three Principles:


Relationships are our first asset: We're one team, built on trust, honesty, and transparency. We value our relationships above all else
Trust drives success: We give each other the space to grow. We empower our employees to succeed, so they can make a real impact
Our customers dream big, just like us: We see the bigger picture and we make sure our customers see it, too. We're always focused on the best outcomes for our clients and for each other, no matter what the goal, or how big the dream


What this means in practice:

At Moneyfarm, our success comes from the impact each of us makes. We move with purpose, urgency, and ambition, focused on delivering outcomes that matter for our clients and our business. Everyone is empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and turn bold ideas into results. As we evolve, we embrace AI as a catalyst for sharper thinking, smarter decisions, and even greater impact.

Our diversity makes this possible. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our creativity and drive better decisions — it's our competitive edge. We value people for who they are and their unique strengths: that's why we offer flexible ways of working to support them in doing their best work.

About The Role

Are you excited about making a real impact on the way Moneyfarm makes decisions? If you are an engineering-minded data analyst ready to get hands-on on a Data Platform supercharged with AI this role is for you.

You will join Moneyfarm's Data Team as a Data Analyst working closely with either product verticals (Trading, Wealth, Pension, Acquisition) or CEO office. You will act as the Data Enabler for your working group, turning raw data into trusted, well-defined information that product managers, business stakeholders (including C-level) and engineers can act on autonomously.

With surface-level output produced by AI, your job will be to orchestrate that work and be accountable for it: reviewing code, creating data models, writing tests, and curating the context our AI agents rely on. You will own the analytical narrative and KPIs of your area and safeguard the quality of its data.

Main Responsibilities:


Build a profound understanding of the business context you will be embedded into
Direct AI tools to build queries, dashboards and reports, and take full accountability for the output
Design, build and maintain analytics-ready DBT data models, applying software-engineering best practices to analytics code
Own the design, definitions, implementation and exhibition of KPIs and metrics for your working group
Act as an Data Enabler with your stream aligned group, facilitating access to data and analysis adjusting to different levels of support for different stakeholders.
Foster trust towards Data Analytics outputs: proactively catch and handle data quality issues.
Refine loosely defined questions into structured analysis plans with clear scope, timelines and tradeoffs. Investigate and interpret data to generate insights that inform business decisions
Contribute the evolution of our Data Platform, with a focus on its AI capabilities: curate the semantic layer, build skills, explore opportunities for further enhancements


Requirements


:2 years of relevant work experience in data analytics or related areas
BSc or higher degree in a quantitative discipline (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science or similar)
Experience in fintech / wealth management is a plus


Skills


Strong curiosity in exploring data and extracting meaningful insights, supported by attention to detail
Sound statistical reasoning and commercial awareness; able to connect analysis to the business decision it supports
Strong SQL is essential. DBT, Airflow and Python are strong plus
Strong experience with BI tools: Tableau, Metabase, Looker and similar. Strong familiarity with spreadsheets.
Solid software-engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), branching, code review, CI/CD, CLI usage
Comfortable reading, reviewing and refactoring analytical code
AI fluency: able to direct AI effectively, detect and handle hallucinations
Excellent written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders; able to lead with the "so what", not just the method
Ability to work autonomously across multiple stakeholders, balancing quality and delivery in an iterative environment
Fluency in English is essential (most stakeholders are UK-based)


Level & Compensation:

We apply CCNL Credito and based on candidate's experience and skills, we will assign the title of Analytics Professional.

Salary range: €32,000 - €40,000 gross/year + bonus, based on experience/competences demonstrated

This role is based in our Milan or Cagliari office and our smart working policy requires as a minimum 2 days of in-office presence per week.

For this role, please upload your CV in English.

Benefits


Health Insurance, Wellness plan
Fee free investments on Moneyfarm platform
Career development opportunities
Training opportunities
Regular office social events

Description:
Job description:

We are looking for a motivated Data Analytics Specialist to join our ICT Team and contribute to our Artificial Intelligence initiatives.
If you're eager to learn, passionate about data and technology, and excited to work in a multicultural and dynamic environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Key Responsibilities
* Collaborate with business and technology leaders to define the AI strategy for data analytics, focusing on decision support and predictive capabilities

* Evaluate and contribute to the selection and implementation of the AI-powered analytics platform, ensuring alignment with Tenova's strategic goals

* Explore and prototype AI/ML models to extract insights from structured and unstructured data, supporting strategic planning and operational excellence

* Support the transition from legacy systems (e.g., SAP BW) by ensuring continuity of data access and quality, while driving innovation through new platforms

* Design and deliver interactive dashboards and visualizations (Power BI or similar) to communicate insights effectively to stakeholders

* Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all analytics and AI initiatives


What we ask for
* Solid experience with SAP Business Warehouse (data modeling, ETL, reporting)

* Strong understanding of data analytics architectures, with interest or experience in AI/ML applications

* Familiarity with Power BI or other BI tools is a plus

* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data-driven solutions

* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

* Fluent in English


What we offer
* The opportunity to work on innovative AI-driven projects with a direct impact on business performance
* A dynamic and international environment where ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged
* Continuous learning opportunities through training, exposure to new technologies and cross-functional collaboration
* Hybrid working model according to company policy and role requirements
* Performance Management through an annual appraisal and development process
* Company canteen available on site
* Supplementary healthcare coverage
* Well-being initiatives to support employees


For the position, the starting gross annual salary will be from € 40.000, with the final offer determined based on the candidate's seniority, experience, and skills, as well as the outcome of the selection process.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Il contesto

Pillar è l'operating system dell'edilizia. ~600 aziende clienti, oltre €2M di ARR in meno di 10 mesi, un team che è passato da 5 a 60 persone in 6 mesi. 

Stiamo costruendo ERP, procurement, marketplace e servizi finanziari per un settore che vale triliardi e gira ancora su Excel e telefonate.

Generiamo già una quantità enorme di dati su clienti, ricavi, utilizzo, onboarding ma i dati da soli non valgono niente. Cerchiamo qualcuno che li trasformi in comprensione. Non in grafici: in decisioni.

Questo ruolo esiste perché abbiamo domande vere e scomode a cui rispondere.

- Quali clienti rimangono e quali no, e cosa li distingue già al giorno zero?

- Quale tipo di onboarding produce i clienti che restano e si espandono?

- etc




Tu sei la persona che va a trovare le risposte.




Cosa farai

Costruirai e manterrai le dashboard sulle metriche che contano davvero: ARR, NRR/GRR, retention, churn, expansion, utilizzo per modulo. Non vanity metrics i numeri su cui prendiamo decisioni.
Vivrai dentro le cohort. Segmenterai i clienti in ogni modo possibile data di firma, dimensione azienda, tipo di azienda, canale di acquisizione, tipo di onboarding, modulo attivato e cercherai i pattern. Perché questa cohort ritiene e quella no? Cosa cambia tra chi espande e chi se ne va?
Analizzerai revenue retention e usage cohort: curve di retention nette e lorde, decadimento dell'utilizzo, attivazione, time-to-value. Capirai non solo che un numero si muove, ma perché.
Lavorerai fianco a fianco col team di prodotto sull'instrumentation. Quando il dato che ti serve non esiste, non ti fermi: definisci gli eventi, ti coordini con prodotto ed engineering e lo fai tracciare.
Trasformerai domande ambigue in risposte difendibili. "Perché la NRR è a questo livello%?” non è un ticket: è un'indagine che segmenti, diagnostichi e chiudi con una raccomandazione.
Porterai gli insight in tavola prima che qualcuno te li chieda. Founder, GTM e prodotto si fideranno dei tuoi numeri e delle tue letture. Zero margin of error.




Cosa NON farai

Non sarai un produttore di dashboard a comando. Non costruiamo grafici belli che nessuno guarda. Se una dashboard non cambia una decisione, non esiste.
Non sarai un data engineer. Devi capire da dove arrivano i dati e saperli interrogare, ma non passerai le giornate a manutenere pipeline. Se ogni tanto ci metti mano, bene ma non è questo il lavoro.
Non farai data science / ML. Questo non è un ruolo da modelli predittivi e training. È analisi di business, fatta con rigore. Niente teatro dell'AI.
Non aspetterai il dataset perfetto. Nessuno ti consegnerà dati puliti e una domanda chiara. Parte del lavoro è farti la domanda giusta e andare a costruire il dato che manca.
Non lavorerai in un silos. Non sei un service desk che evade richieste. Sei in stanza con chi decide, e ci aspettiamo che tu abbia opinioni.
Non farai reporting fine a sé stesso. Niente report mensili compilati perché "si è sempre fatto così". Ogni cosa che produci ha un perché.




Cosa cerchiamo

Esperienza solida (idealmente 3+ anni) in analytics di business in una SaaS / scale-up. La cohort analysis dev'essere una seconda natura, non qualcosa che hai sentito nominare.
SQL fluente non negoziabile. Forte con almeno un tool di BI (Metabase, Looker, Tableau o simili). Python è un must. Bonus se hai già lavorato con product analytics (es. PostHog) e Postgres/Supabase.
Padronanza vera delle metriche SaaS: ARR, NRR/GRR, retention per cohort, LTV/CAC, attivazione, expansion. Sai cosa significano e sai quando mentono.
Mentalità da cacciatore di pattern: curioso, scettico verso le medie, guardi le distribuzioni e non solo i totali. Quando un numero ti sorprende, scavi finché non capisci.
A tuo agio nell'ambiguità. Sai trasformare una domanda vaga del founder in un'analisi chiara, e sai dire "questo numero non vuol dire quello che pensi".
Sai parlare due lingue: quella tecnica con prodotto ed engineering (eventi, tracking, schema) e quella di business con founder e GTM.
Italiano e inglese fluenti. Curiosità per l'edilizia, il fintech o il vertical SaaS è un bonus.




Come lavoriamo

Siamo diretti, veloci e allergici alla fuffa. Diamo contesto e autonomia, non micromanagement. Preferiamo una verità scomoda a una slide ottimista.




Comp

Salary starting at 40k
2k wellfare
buoni pasto
ESOP




Se questo ti suona come casa, scrivici.

  • SQL fluente non negoziabile. Forte con almeno un tool di BI (Metabase, Looker, Tableau o simili). Python è un must. Bonus se hai già lavorato con product analytics (es. PostHog) e Postgres/Supabase.
  • Padronanza vera delle metriche SaaS: ARR, NRR/GRR, retention per cohort, LTV/CAC, attivazione, expansion. Sai cosa significano e sai quando mentono.
  • Mentalità da cacciatore di pattern: curioso, scettico verso le medie, guardi le distribuzioni e non solo i totali. Quando un numero ti sorprende, scavi finché non capisci.
  • A tuo agio nell'ambiguità. Sai trasformare una domanda vaga del founder in un'analisi chiara, e sai dire "questo numero non vuol dire quello che pensi".
  • Sai parlare due lingue: quella tecnica con prodotto ed engineering (eventi, tracking, schema) e quella di business con founder e GTM.
  • Italiano e inglese fluenti. Curiosità per l'edilizia, il fintech o il vertical SaaS è un bonus.


Come lavoriamo

Siamo diretti, veloci e allergici alla fuffa. Diamo contesto e autonomia, non micromanagement. Preferiamo una verità scomoda a una slide ottimista.


Comp

  • Salary starting at 40k
  • 2k wellfare
  • buoni pasto
  • ESOP

Collabora ed è di supporto ai propri stakeholder e ne comprende problemi, obiettivi e priorità, detenendo ownership su identificazione e implementazione delle soluzioni.

Sviluppa dashboard, analisi e prodotti data, con grande attenzione alla trasmissibilità degli stessi in un’ottica di industrializzazione degli asset.

Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ruolo analogo.
Padronanza di SQL e buona familiarità con Python.
Attitudine problem-first e comprovata esperienza nella capacità di definire il successo di iniziative basandosi su outcome (risultati finali / impatto) vs output (deliverable di progetto).

Conoscenza di strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dati (es. Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
Conoscenza della lingua inglese fluente
Plus: Conoscenza applicata di strumenti AI agentici (e.g. Claude Code, Codex).

Percorsi di crescita internazionali – Mobilità interna Gruppo Adeo
Formazione continua – training on the job + learning platform digitale

Sistema incentivante e Azionariato diffuso
Sconti collaboratori

Title: Data Analyst Specialist
Description:
In Mavriq, parte di Moltiply Group, aiutiamo le persone a fare la scelta giusta - che si tratti di un mutuo, un’assicurazione, una fornitura di energia o un piano telefonico. I nostri brand, tra cui MutuiOnline.it, Segugio.it, SOStariffe.it, Trovaprezzi.it, Switcho, e realtà internazionali come LeLynx.fr, Rastreator.com, Pricewise.nl e Verivox.de, offrono chiarezza in mercati spesso complessi e poco trasparenti. Crediamo nel potere dei dati, nella trasparenza e nell’innovazione - perché cambiare le regole, quando non funzionano al meglio, è nel nostro DNA.

Posizione:

Stiamo cercando un/una Data Analyst Specialist che si unisca al nostro team per garantire l’integrità, l’affidabilità e la coerenza dei dati all’interno dei nostri sistemi. La figura avrà un ruolo chiave nel monitoraggio continuo dei rilasci, nella verifica della qualità dei dati e nell'identificazione tempestiva di anomalie o scostamenti rispetto agli standard attesi.

L’obiettivo principale è assicurare che i dati rimangano accurati, completi e allineati ai requisiti di business, supportando i team tecnici e operativi nelle attività di controllo e miglioramento continuo.

Cosa offriamo

Crediamo che la crescita nasca dall’incontro tra curiosità e autonomia. Offriamo un ambiente ibrido e flessibile, formazione continua e spazio per sperimentare, imparare e migliorare. Lavorerai in un team con cui condividerai successi, affronterai sfide e raggiungerai risultati. A completare il quadro, un pacchetto di benefit solido: assicurazione sanitaria (CCNL Commercio), buoni pasto, welfare, e accesso a piattaforme di e-learning.

Dove lavorerai

La nostra sede è in Via Desenzano 2, Milano (MM1 Gambara). Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida: almeno due giorni a settimana in ufficio e fino a tre in smart working. I momenti in presenza sono fondamentali per confrontarci, scambiare idee e alimentare la cultura di squadra che ci distingue.

Cosa Farai


Monitorare regolarmente i rilasci applicativi e valutare l’impatto sui dati.
Eseguire controlli di qualità dei dati (Data Quality Check) su base periodica e on-demand.
Identificare anomalie, inconsistenze e deviazioni rispetto ai benchmark attesi.
Collaborare con i team di sviluppo, prodotto e business per risolvere eventuali problemi legati ai dati.
Creare e mantenere report, dashboard e metriche di monitoraggio della data quality.
Documentare processi, controlli e risultati delle analisi.
Contribuire alla definizione e implementazione di regole di Data Quality e flussi di monitoraggio automatizzato.
Proporre soluzioni e miglioramenti ai processi di gestione del dato.


Requisiti:


Ottima conoscenza di SQL e capacità di interrogare database complessi.
Buona conoscenza di strumenti di data visualization (es. Power BI, Tableau).
Esperienza con Excel e strumenti di analisi.
Familiarità con processi di ETL, data pipeline e concetti di data governance.
Conoscenza dei principali indicatori di Data Quality (accuratezza, completezza, coerenza, tempestività, unicità).
Laurea in discipline STEM (Informatica, Statistica, Matematica, Ingegneria o affini).
1–3 anni di esperienza in ruoli simili (Data Analyst, Data Quality Specialist, Business Analyst).
Conoscenza del ciclo di vita del software e gestione dei rilasci (nice to have).


Altre informazioni:

In Mavriq non diamo nulla per scontato: pensiamo, testiamo, impariamo.

Ogni giorno è un giorno uno, e ogni sfida è un’occasione per migliorare.

Se ti rivedi in questo approccio, non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti.

(La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle Leggi n. 903/77 e n. 125/91.)

Title: Data Analytics & Integrations Specialist
Description:
MET Group is an integrated European energy company, headquartered in Switzerland, with activities in natural gas and power, focused on multi-commodity wholesale, trading and sales, as well as energy infrastructure and industrial assets.



MET Group is present in 30 national gas markets and 39 international trading hubs. The Group has a significant end-consumer presence in Croatia, Italy, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, and Spain.



MET Group has 1000+ permanent staff. The company is owned 90% by MET employees and 10% by Keppel Infrastructure, a wholly owned subsidiary of Keppel Corporation*.



MET Energia Italia is the Italian subsidiary or MET Group, an integrated European energy company, headquartered in Switzerland and active in 16 EU countries, with activities in natural gas, power and renewables, focused on multi-commodity trading and sales, as well as renewables and Energy Efficiency Solutions. After its start up in 2017, MET Energia Italia has now reached a position among the top 20 energy players in the country.



MET Energia Italia’s mission is to become a leading market player by implementing innovation in the Italian energy market. We are a boutique of energy professionals who, thanks to our expertise and hard work, have been able to establish a competitive and highly optimized business in a few years. We are determined to take our success story even further, so we strive to attract highly talented people that are ready to give their best every day and that are eager to continuously develop their skills by taking on big challenges.





Job Description



As we continue to evolve our client portfolio and expand, MET Energia Italia is now looking for a talented Data Analytics & Integrations Specialist, who will contribute to the company's growth and support its digital transformation journey.



As Data Analytics Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data management and business intelligence solutions that support business operations and decision-making. Working closely with internal stakeholders and the MET Group Analytics team, you will translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, develops data models and reporting tools, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and data-driven capabilities across the organization.



As Integrations Specialist, you will be responsible for gathering and tracking functional requirements, developing and maintaining operational automations built in Azure Databricks, and managing integrations between business applications, data platforms, and Databricks. You will ensure seamless data flows, support process automation initiatives, and contribute to the reliability and efficiency of the company's technology ecosystem.



As part of the IT team, you will progressively take ownership of a variety of activities, making a valuable contribution to our daily operations through the following responsibilities:



Collaborate with Met Group Analytics team on BI activities, design, functional analysis, upgrading and maintenance
Define user requirements and translating them into technical specifications documents and develop solutions with existing or new tools
Improve existing systems and take care of the implementation process of new applications designed and chosen to maximize the productivity of the company and its activities
Data Modelling and database development tools PL/SQL (mainly Oracle and MS SQL Server)
Develop and maintain SQL and Python scripts to support data analytics, system integrations, and process automation
Communicate and transform information into effective visual presentations (data visualization, presentation skills, incl. mastery of Power Point)
Supporting the launch of new ideas and projects to grow the business
Be active and ready to take on new challenges in other areas of MET should this become your desire


Qualifications


BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Knowledge of and experience within the energy sector is preferred
3-5 years of experience as SQL/Phyton Developer
Strong expertise in data modeling principles and methodologies, including conceptual, logical and physical data models
Basic knowledge of troubleshooting and problem analysis
Proficiency in web services technologies (e.g. REST, JSON, XML, SOAP, etc.)
Demonstrate strong analytical thinking and a proactive approach toward adopting emerging technologies
Build and maintain collaborative relationships across diverse teams and external partners
Effectively manage stakeholder expectations while navigating competing priorities in a dynamic environment
Excellent technical support and problem-solving capabilities, with a focus on efficiently resolving user queries and issues
Ability to effectively prioritize workload, manage multiple responsibilities, and consistently meet deadlines
Fluent in Italian with a strong command of English

TECHNICAL SKILLS



Required



Strong knowledge of Oracle Database, SQL/PLSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server
Experience with Databricks, Python, Power BI, and Power Query
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, Power Pivot, and data visualization tools
Knowledge of REST APIs and process automation solutions such as Microsoft Power Automate

Preferred



Experience with big data and distributed processing technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Flink, Hadoop Ecosystem, HDFS, S3)
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure data platforms, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Key Vault
Familiarity with Java, Salesforce development (Apex, Flows, Triggers), and modern front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular)
Understanding of cloud infrastructure and security concepts, including VPC and IAM


Additional Information


Permanent employment contract
The position is aligned with Level 2 of the CCNL Commercio. Final remuneration will be determined based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including experience, skills, and qualifications.
The opportunity to make a tangible impact on company performance and growth
A dynamic, innovative, and fast-growing environment that values new ideas and encourages individual contribution
An open and informal culture, with a high level of trust and autonomy
Exposure to an international environment, with opportunities to collaborate and share knowledge with colleagues across MET Group, particularly the Swiss headquarters

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Profilo della posizione

La persona sarà inserita nella Direzione Business Operations & Innovation, all'interno della Funzione Data Strategy.

Riportando al Responsabile del team, la/il candidata/o si occuperà principalmente di ottimizzare e valorizzare l’ecosistema dati aziendale sviluppando metodologie e progettualità data driven evolute per innovare i processi aziendali e abilitare nuove opportunità di business. In particolare, tra i principali ambiti rientrano le seguenti responsabilità:

gestione tramite data management platform e datalake
gestione quotidiana dei segmenti di audience che compongono l’offerta a target (analisi, aggiornamento, diagnostica)
implementazione, controllo e ottimizzazione di strumenti di forecasting per la gestione delle audience e delle campagne pubblicitarie a target
progetti di reporting evoluto, data visualization e predisposizione di strumenti e dashborad di analisi, ottimizzazione e automazione
advanced analytics per progetti data enrichment e data activation
monitoraggio e ottimizzazione della performance dei profili di audience attraverso i tool in dotazione (adserver, DMP, datalake, etc)
traduzione di requisiti di business in analisi e progettualità data driven
punto di riferimento per le differenti divisioni aziendali per attività di gestione dati e di analisi avanzate




Profilo della/del candidata/o

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Descrizione azienda




Fides è una tech company che da vent’anni si contraddistingue sul mercato per una doppia offerta di servizio: partnership consulenziali con i più importanti system integrator internazionali e sviluppo di progetti IT custom.




Grazie a 20 anni di esperienza e oltre 300 risorse dislocate tra le sedi (Milano, Napoli, Roma e Torino), Fides si posiziona tra le principali aziende italiane Hi-tech.




Le competenze e i progetti Fides si estendono dal Banking & Finance, al Digital Retail, alle tecnologie per il Monitoraggio Ambientale, ai Servizi e Soluzioni ICT per l’Industry 4.0, per l’e-commerce e la logistica.




Posizione




Per un importante progetto in ambito Data & Analytics, siamo alla ricerca di un BI / Data Analyst con una solida esperienza nell’interrogazione, nell’integrazione e nella modellazione dei dati, affiancata da competenze avanzate nello sviluppo di report e dashboard.




La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato nella gestione e valorizzazione del dato e sarà coinvolta nell’intero ciclo di sviluppo delle soluzioni di Business Intelligence: dall’acquisizione e trasformazione delle informazioni fino alla definizione dei KPI, alla modellazione dei dati e alla realizzazione degli strumenti di reporting.




Ti occuperai della gestione end-to-end dei flussi dati provenienti da fonti differenti, del monitoraggio della qualità delle informazioni e dello sviluppo di soluzioni di reporting performanti, accessibili e coerenti con le esigenze degli stakeholder di business.




Sarai inoltre coinvolto/a nel governo delle piattaforme di Business Intelligence, nella gestione degli accessi e degli aspetti di sicurezza, nel supporto agli utenti e nella produzione della documentazione funzionale e tecnica.




La modalità di lavoro sarà ibrida, con presenza richiesta presso l’ufficio di Milano almeno una volta a settimana.




Requisiti




Competenze tecniche




Esperienza nel ruolo di BI Analyst, Data Analyst o in posizioni analoghe in ambito Data & Analytics
Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di flussi dati, incluse attività di integrazione, trasformazione e modellazione
Competenze avanzate nell’utilizzo di Power BI
Esperienza nella modellazione tabellare e nello sviluppo di misure e logiche tramite DAX
Conoscenza e utilizzo della Row-Level Security, RLS
Esperienza nello sviluppo, nella manutenzione e nell’ottimizzazione di report e dashboard
Conoscenza di JasperReports
Solida esperienza nella modellazione dati per soluzioni di Business Intelligence e Data Warehousing
Ottima conoscenza di Oracle e del linguaggio SQL
Conoscenza di PL/SQL
Esperienza con SQL Server
Conoscenza dei processi di integrazione dati tramite API REST
Esperienza nella definizione, implementazione e validazione di metriche e KPI
Competenze in attività di Data Quality, monitoraggio delle anomalie e gestione delle relative azioni correttive
Esperienza nella gestione e nel governo di piattaforme di Business Intelligence, inclusi sicurezza, accessi e monitoraggio delle performance
Conoscenza della piattaforma Microsoft Azure
Gradita esperienza con Azure Data Factory
Gradita conoscenza di Azure Databricks
Capacità di produrre e aggiornare documentazione funzionale e tecnica relativa a processi, dati e soluzioni di reporting




Competenze Trasversali




Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio, per garantire l’affidabilità delle analisi e dei risultati
Capacità di affrontare problemi complessi e individuare soluzioni basate sui dati
Autonomia nella gestione e nel completamento delle attività assegnate
Flessibilità e capacità di adattarsi a nuovi strumenti, dataset e contesti in evoluzione
Buone capacità di collaborazione e confronto con stakeholder tecnici e di business




Altre Informazioni




Cosa offriamo




Retribuzione annua lorda compresa tra 42.000 e 48.000 euro, definita in base al profilo, alle competenze e all’esperienza maturata.




Sono inoltre previsti buoni pasto, assicurazione sanitaria aggiuntiva e percorsi di formazione interna con simulazioni AI per attività di upskilling e reskilling.




Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro giovane e innovativo, caratterizzato da feedback continui e orientati alla crescita professionale.

Title: Data Specialist
HTML:
Allitude S.p.a., società del Gruppo Bancario Cooperativo Cassa Centrale Banca specializzata in servizi di sviluppo software, outsourcing informatico e back-office per il Settore bancario, sta selezionando una figura di Data Specialist da inserire all’interno della direzione tecnica Data Platform Services, che gestisce i servizi di datawarehouse, data transformation, reporting e analytics del Gruppo Cassa Centrale.


Nell’ufficio Data Platform & Analytics, all’intero della Direzione tecnica Data Platform Services, la risorsa sarà responsabile delle seguenti attività:

  • Effettuare analisi di vario genere sui dati e redigere/supervisionare l’opportuna documentazione funzionale per dare una piena rappresentazione del patrimonio informativo in Data Platform
  • Partecipare attivamente a progetti in ambito dati, contribuendo alle varie attività dalla raccolta requisiti, all’analisi tecnico/funzionale, al supporto alla progettazione, sviluppo e roll out in produzione, e agendo da punto di riferimento in tali progetti per la direzione Data Platform Services e coordinandone le attività
  • Interagire proattivamente con gli utenti di business e con le altre funzioni interne alle direzioni tecniche Allitude per comprendere appieno le richieste/necessità e disegnare le soluzioni conseguenti nel rispetto delle best practices in ambito dati
  • Occuparsi, oltre ai progetti, anche delle attività di run e business as usual in Data Platform, contribuendo all’analisi e soluzione di problemi in produzione, supportando la gestione ordinata dei servizi IT (seguendo i processi di incident, problem, change, etc ..) e promuovendo automatizzazione e miglioramento
  • Contribuire all’evoluzione tecnologica della Data Platform ponendosi con piena disponibilità di fronte al cambiamento, abbracciando l’utilizzo di nuovi strumenti e favorendo una spinta verso l’innovazione


Competenze necessarie:

  • laurea in discipline tecnico/scientifiche (informatica, ingegneria, matematica, fisica, statistica);
  • conoscenza funzionale di base ed interesse per il settore bancario e assicurativo;
  • forte interesse per l’analisi dei dati e familiarità con le tematiche di Data Analytics;
  • conoscenza nell’esplorazione e analisi dei dati sui principali databases relazionali (con focus particolare su tecnologie Oracle) e conoscenza dei principali concetti: tabelle, viste, partizioni, indici, procedure, sinonimi;
  • conoscenza avanzata di SQL e conoscenza basic di Unix, Shell, Python;
  • capacità nella modellazione dei dati (concettuale, logica e fisica) e dei diversi tipi di modello dati (plus: esperienza con un qualche tool di data modelling);
  • conoscenza di tematiche di data governance: data quality, data lineage, data dictionary, etc
  • buone capacità di problem solving, team working, comunicazione, proattività, attitudine analitica e attenzione e cura dei dettagli;
  • disponibilità e esperienza nell’interazione con system integrators esterni all’azienda per integrare la capacity del team con sviluppatori, analisti, project managers, e supervisione delle attività svolte da tali profili;
  • capacità di comunicare in modo efficace con utenti e responsabili di altri uffici sia ICT sia business;


Costituiscono titolo preferenziale:

  • conoscenza ed esperienza su prodotti della suite INFORMATICA (Powercenter ed EDC);
  • conoscenza ed esperienza su Databricks;
  • conoscenza ed esperienza su un qualche tool di business intelligence (es. PowerBI, Qlik);
  • conoscenza ed esperienza su cloud Microsoft Azure;



Cosa troverai da noi:

Entrando in Allitude troverai un'azienda giovane e meritocratica che punta sulla crescita delle persone attraverso la formazione mirata allo sviluppo di hard e soft skill. I/le neoassunti/e hanno l’opportunità di partecipare a diverse iniziative volte a sviluppare un mindset innovativo e ad arricchire la conoscenza organizzativa e le competenze trasversali. Avrai la possibilità di lavorare in un’azienda che vanta un forte know how nell’ambito dei servizi bancari e tecnologici derivante dalle conoscenze pregresse delle aziende integrate. Potrai lavorare a progetti che puntano al miglioramento continuo e all'innovazione dei modelli di business delle nostre banche clienti.



Per questa posizione è previsto un trattamento economico non inferiore ai minimi tabellari stabiliti dal CCNL applicabile per l’inquadramento indicato.

Indicazione economica minima (base): a partire da €35.650 RAL (minimo contrattuale per Terza Area Professionale Primo Livello).


I nostri benefit principali:

  • Smartworking
  • Assicurazione sanitaria
  • Fondo pensione
  • Buoni pasto da 8€ al giorno
  • Premi di risultato
  • Premi individuali una tantum
  • Agevolazioni bancarie
  • Welfare aziendale


Possibili sedi di lavoro: Milano, Trento o Bologna (modalità ibrida)

La suddetta ricerca è aperta a candidature di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso, in ottemperanza e nel rispetto del d.lgs. 198/2006. Per i valori a cui ci ispiriamo, prestiamo particolare attenzione alla diversità, all’inclusività e alla tutela dell’equilibrio fra vita privata e vita professionale.

Title: Data Analyst - CRM e Loyalty
Description:
Leroy Merlin, brand internazionale del gruppo Adeo, leader nel settore retail home improvement, bricolage e fai-da-te, è presente nelle principali città italiane con una missione chiara: aiutare le persone a realizzare i loro progetti di casa e di vita, offrendo soluzioni innovative e ad alto impatto positivo.




Chi cerchiamo

Stiamo cercando un/una Data Analyst da inserire nel team Analytics della direzione Finance & Performance. Con un focus prevalente sull’area Marketing & CRM, il ruolo agisce come partner strategico del business al fine di contribuire all’ottimizzazione e allo sviluppo della strategia di customer retention di Leroy Merlin Italia sui diversi canali.




Responsabilità del ruolo

Lavorare con i propri stakeholder per comprenderne problemi, obiettivi e priorità, detenendo ownership su identificazione e implementazione delle soluzioni.
Diventare domain expert dell’area CRM e Loyalty, contribuendo allo sviluppo della data platform aziendale insieme al team Data Engineering, con l’obiettivo di rimuovere le soluzioni legacy e evitare la generazione di debito tecnico.
Sviluppare dashboard, analisi e prodotti data, con grande attenzione alla trasmissibilità degli stessi in un’ottica di industrializzazione degli asset.
Gestire in autonomia backlog e priorità, concentrandosi su attività a maggior valore aggiunto.
Comunicare i risultati del proprio lavoro in modo chiaro e accessibile, favorendone la comprensione e garantendo - quando possibile - una stima dell'impatto delle decisioni prese grazie al proprio contributo.
Diffondere competenze e best practice analitiche, diventando riferimento per Business Partner e Performance Leader.




Qualifiche e competenze

Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ruolo analogo.
Padronanza di SQL e buona familiarità con Python.
Attitudine problem-first e comprovata esperienza nella capacità di definire il successo di iniziative basandosi su outcome (risultati finali / impatto) vs output (deliverable di progetto).
Esperienza con metodologie statistiche e modelli predittivi, in particolare nel ramo disciplinare del marketing e dell’analisi di incrementalità (uplift modeling, causal inference, counterfactual analysis).
Familiarità con i concetti di attribuzione digitale e le dinamiche di customer churn e retention.
Conoscenza di strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dati (es. Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
Conoscenza della lingua inglese fluente




Cosa offriamo:

Percorsi di crescita internazionali – Mobilità interna Gruppo Adeo
Formazione continua – training on the job + learning platform digitale
Per questa posizione è previsto un range retributivo annuo lordo compreso tra 34.500 e 48.000. La proposta economica sarà commisurata all'esperienza, alle competenze e al percorso professionale, nel rispetto dell'inquadramento previsto per il ruolo.
Sistema incentivante e Azionariato diffuso
Sconti collaboratori
Assistenza sanitaria (FondoEst)




In Leroy Merlin crediamo nella diversità come leva fondamentale per il nostro successo e accogliamo con favore le candidature di tutti i membri della società.




Il tuo percorso in Leroy Merlin inizia da qui! Candidati ora e inizia la tua crescita con noi.

Title: Data Analist Professional
Description:
Wat jij mag verwachten

Als Data Analyst Professional speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen en uitbouwen van ons centrale datamodel en de semantische laag. Je werkt met moderne tools zoals Microsoft Fabric, DBT en Power BI en neemt ownership over modellering, standaarden en best practices. Daarnaast ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor collega’s en help je hen groeien in expertise.Je rapporteert aan de Teamlead Resource Pool Data en werkt voornamelijk op de gold layer, waar je businessnoden vertaalt naar consistente, schaalbare datamodellen die écht gebruikt worden.

Zo ziet jouw takenpakket eruit

Je ontwerpt en implementeert robuuste, businessgerichte datamodellen in DBT (dimensioneel, business-driven).
Je bouwt en onderhoudt het centrale datamodel (gold layer).
Je definieert en bewaakt standaarden rond modellering, naming conventions en versioning.
Je integreert data uit verschillende bronnen tot één coherent en herbruikbaar geheel.
Je waakt over data-consistentie, kwaliteit en herbruikbaarheid.
Je werkt nauw samen met data engineers (brondata → silver → gold).
Je vertaalt businessvragen naar KPI’s, measures en semantische definities.
Je maakt self-service analytics mogelijk via duidelijke datasets en governance.
Je fungeert als sparringpartner voor business stakeholders.
Je geeft gerichte opleidingen over het gebruik en de inhoud van semantische modellen.
Je stimuleert kennisdeling en draagt bij aan de verdere maturiteit van het team.




Wat wij verwachten

Must‑haves

Sterke ervaring (enkele jaren) in datamodellering en analytics
Aantoonbare ervaring met DBT (modelling, testing, documentation)
Zeer goede kennis van SQL
Ervaring met Power BI (focus op datasets en semantische modellen)
Sterk inzicht in dimensionele modellering (facts & dimensions)
Ervaring in samenwerking met data engineers en stakeholders
Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden




Nice‑to‑haves

Ervaring met Microsoft Fabric of gelijkaardige platforms
Ervaring met data governance tools (bv. Purview)
Kennis van Git, data contracten en CI/CD
Ervaring in Agile/Scrum omgevingen

Title: Data & Simulation Specialist
Description:
Cartamundi is wereldmarktleider in “play”-oplossingen. Denk aan speelkaarten, kaart- en bordspellen, collectibles en trading card games.

Ons doel? “Live Different, Play Different” voor iedereen. Met bijna 3.000 mensen zetten we ons elke dag in om die ambitie waar te maken. Ons familiebedrijf, met hoofdkantoor in België, heeft daarvoor een wereldwijd netwerk van designcenters, verkoopkantoren en productiefaciliteiten. Een netwerk dat loopt van de VS en Brazilië tot Europa en Japan.

Cartamundi heeft een wereldwijde merkenportefeuille met heritage brands zoals Bicycle®, Bee®, Copag®, Shuffle® en heel wat lokaal geliefde merken. We zijn ook de vertrouwde partner van toonaangevende speelgoed- en entertainmentbedrijven voor productie- en distributieoplossingen.

De drukpersen van Cartamundi draaien al sinds 1765. We koppelen die rijke traditie aan innovatie in digitale en hybride speelervaringen. Om zo relevant te blijven – vandaag en morgen.

Cartamundi voert een strategie van duurzame en winstgevende groei. Op die manier streven we ernaar om onze planeet en ons bedrijf in topconditie te houden voor de komende generaties.




Lees meer op www.cartamundi.com

Volg ons op LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/cartamundi




Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.




Jouw functie

Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…




…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen

Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.




…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z

Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.




…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses

Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.




…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit

Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.




…Optimaliseer je tools en processen

Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.




…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners

Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.




Jouw profiel

Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…

Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.




Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. Je krijgt de mogelijkheden jezelf te ontwikkelen. Het salarispakket is in overeenstemming met je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.

Title: Data Analyst/Engineer
Description:
We are wizards who turn data into knowledge. We execute E2E projects in team and work as consultants for various clients (and sectors) – partly on-site/partly from home – to assist them with Microsoft data solutions. Our credo is to empower every professional to make the best data-driven decision. Transforming data into usable knowledge is something you have right at your fingertips.




Your role as a Data Analyt/Engineer

Within this role, you will also contribute to data modelling activities in Power BI environments or data warehouses, translating business requirements into structured data models and validating them with stakeholders.




Managing and customising the ETL or ELT process (Extract, transform, load)

Setting up and customising data integrations and data modelling (SSIS , SSAS, SSRS)

You will be using Microsoft data services on-premise or in Azure, or a combination of both.




Project-based or long-term assignments, all options are on the table. Depending on the assignment, you may be working on your own or in a team, taking care of the project management yourself or not. Participating in pre-sales is also a possibility. The trump cards of this job are variety and continuous learning through experience.




But don’t worry.




The roles within assignments and their complexity will be tailored to you: sufficiently challenging for learning and not over your head. If you demonstrate a keenness to learn, independence and initiative, you will be absolutely fine. Don’t forget that you have a team of helpful Koherians standing behind you who will be happy to help you and facilitate your development.




Experience and Technical skills

3 to 6 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Data Engineer or similar data role
Hands-on experience with Power BI
Experience with Azure Data Lake services
Strong knowledge of T-SQL and ETL development using Azure components or on-premise tools such as Azure Data Factory or SSIS
Experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse Analytics is an asset
Knowledge of Python or Databricks is a plus




Languages

Fluency in Dutch and English is a must, and fluency in French would be a bonus.




Are you our next Data Wizard? Don't hesitate and apply!

Title: Data Migration Analyst
Description:
Een internationale speler, met een sterk hoofdkantoor in de regio Gent, is een toonaangevende groep gespecialiseerd in innovatieve isolatieoplossingen. Met meer dan 1.500 medewerkers verspreid over Europa en een jaarlijkse omzet van zo'n €600 miljoen, groeit deze organisatie sterk via een actieve buy-and-buildstrategie. Om de verdere digitale integratie en de migratie van diverse entiteiten naar één centraal Dynamics 365 F&O-platform in goede banen te leiden, zoeken zij versterking voor het interne IT-team.




Als Data Migration Analyst word je voor een periode van ongeveer 1 jaar de trekkende kracht achter de datamigraties. In deze rol analyseer je brondata, stel je accurate mappings op en zorg je voor een vlekkeloze data-uitvoering en -validatie, waarbij de focus voornamelijk ligt op complexe productie-, voorraad- en supplychaindata.




Hoe zal jouw takenpakket eruit zien?

Je analyseert brondata uit verschillende bronnetwerken en bepaalt de juiste transformatieregels, mappings en logica voor D365 F&O.
Je voert dataloads uit via het D365 F&O Data Management Framework en lost technische of inhoudelijke importfouten op.
Je stelt validatiechecks en controletotalen op om de kwaliteit en juistheid van de gemigreerde data te garanderen.
Je analyseert en ondersteunt specifiek de migratie van complexe productie-, voorraad- en supplychaindata, waaronder BOMs, routes en magazijnstructuren.
Je werkt nauw samen met functionele consultants, ontwikkelaars en data-eigenaren gedurende het gehele migratietraject en de cutover-fase.




Wat verwachten wij van jou?

Een master of bachelordiploma in een relevante richting.
Grondige praktijkkennis van D365 F&O, het Data Management Framework en geavanceerde SQL-vaardigheden.
Aantoonbare ervaring met data profiling, source-to-target mapping, ETL-processen en datamigraties binnen een ERP-omgeving.
Sterke affiniteit met en kennis van productie-, manufacturing- of supplychainprocessen.
Een vlotte en heldere communicatie in het Nederlands en Engels, gecombineerd met een gestructureerde en detailgerichte aanpak
Je bent een echte initiatiefnemer die direct zijn meerwaarde kan bieden.




Wat bieden wij jou?

Een dagtarief tussen de €600 en €800 per dag op basis van jouw ervaring.
Een uitdagende freelance opdracht met een verwachte duurtijd van ongeveer 1 jaar.
De kans om mee te bouwen aan een grootschalig, internationaal ERP-migratieproject.
Een omgeving waar autonomie, ondernemerschap en een no-nonsense aanpak centraal staan.
Flexibele werkomstandigheden binnen een ambitieuze en dynamische organisatie, office policy hierbij is dat er 3 dagen vanuit het kantoor wordt gewerkt.




Bekijk zeker ook de website voor meer vacatures in IT: https://jobs.kwery.be/

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
🚛 About Qargo

Qargo is a cloud-based (SaaS) Transport Management Platform. We are a scale-up based in London and Ghent (Belgium), rapidly expanding across Europe. The platform is an ‘all-in-one system’, handling everything from initial order entry to final invoicing. It optimises planning and has a built-in AI feature that automates lengthy manual tasks. Qargo is designed to help modern logistics operations run more efficiently, while increasing profitability and sustainability.

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our team in Ghent. If you’re looking to work in an international company in a role that offers autonomy, ownership and impact, this is the role for you!

💼 About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping Qargo's data landscape. You'll build and maintain reliable data models, develop impactful dashboards, and turn complex datasets into actionable insights that support decision-making across the organisation.

This role offers plenty of variety and impact. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, sales, account management, finance, and customer onboarding teams to help make data a strategic asset for Qargo.

You'll contribute to both internal and customer-facing dashboards, help scale our data infrastructure, and support the continued growth of our analytics capabilities as Qargo expands.

🔑 Key Responsibilities


Build, maintain and improve Qargo's data models and data pipelines, ensuring reliable and high-quality data.
Maintain, extend and optimise our in-app Lightdash dashboards, including operational, financial, and performance insights.
Build and refine internal BI dashboards to support data-driven decision-making across departments.
Develop account management dashboards that reveal feature adoption, revenue insights, and upsell opportunities.
Create product and engineering analytics, including feature usage dashboards using Mixpanel or custom-built tracking solutions.
Support integration-related reporting by building dashboards that provide visibility into integration health, tenant usage, and performance.
Build billing and cost-analysis dashboards, including API call cost allocation and tenant-level breakdowns.
Continuously improve our analytics environment by identifying opportunities to optimise data quality, reporting, and processes.


✅ Skills & Experience


At least 2 years of experience in data analytics, BI engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar role in a SaaS or data-driven environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL, data modelling, and dashboarding tools (Lightdash, Superset, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).
Experience with analytics platforms such as Mixpanel and user behaviour tracking methodologies is a plus.
Comfortable collaborating with multidisciplinary teams including product, engineering, sales, and finance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to data quality and scalability.
A background in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn, take ownership, and continuously improve.


🤝 What We Offer


Real impact and ownership in a growing international scale-up.
A supportive and collaborative team culture.
Hybrid working setup with flexibility and trust.
Opportunities to learn, grow, and expand your technical knowledge.
Competitive salary and benefits package.

Title: Decision Intelligence Developer
Description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond.

Your journey with us

We’re seeking a talented Data Skill Builder to join our Supply Chain Data Team. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between complex data systems and actionable insights—extracting, transforming, and visualizing data from diverse sources to fuel intelligent decision-making. You’ll work closely with architects and business stakeholders to build robust data pipelines and compelling analytics that drive supply chain optimization. If you’re passionate about turning raw data into business value and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this is your opportunity to make a tangible impact.

What You’ll Do


Data Extraction & Integration: Extract data from multiple enterprise systems (ERP, WMS, TMS, planning tools) and third-party sources; design and build reliable data pipelines that consolidate information into unified datasets
Data Analysis & Transformation: Perform exploratory data analysis, identify data quality issues, and transform raw data into clean, structured formats ready for analytics and modeling
Analytics Development: Develop analytical queries, dashboards, and reports that surface key insights; translate business questions into data-driven answers
Data Visualization: Create compelling visualizations and interactive dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) that communicate complex data stories to business stakeholders in clear, actionable ways
Collaboration with Architects: Work closely with Solution Architects to understand technical requirements; implement data solutions according to architectural specifications and best practices
Data Quality & Governance: Implement data validation checks, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation; ensure data consistency and reliability across systems
Continuous Learning: Stay current with data engineering tools, analytics techniques, and emerging technologies; contribute ideas for improving data processes and methodologies


Let's Talk About You


Data Engineering Fundamentals: 3+ years of hands-on experience building data pipelines, ETL processes, and working with SQL and relational/non-relational databases
Programming Proficiency: Strong experience with Python, SQL, or similar languages; ability to write clean, maintainable code and debug technical issues independently
Analytics & Visualization: Demonstrated expertise with analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and statistical analysis; ability to translate data into compelling visual narratives
Cloud & Data Platforms: Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience working with data warehouses, data lakes, or big data platforms (Spark, Hadoop)
Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical thinking; ability to break down complex data challenges and find practical solutions with minimal guidance
Communication Skills: Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders; comfortable presenting findings and collaborating across teams
Passion for Data: Genuine curiosity about data; track record of delivering data projects that drove measurable business insights or operational improvements


Primary Focus: Data Excellence Over Platform Specificity

While Familiarity With Aera Technology Is a Nice-to-have, Data Engineering And Analytics Expertise Is What Matters Most. We Value Professionals Who


Prioritize data quality, pipeline reliability, and analytical rigor above platform-specific knowledge
Can quickly learn new tools and platforms as business needs evolve
Understand when to build custom solutions vs. leverage existing platforms
Bring deep experience with core data technologies: Python, SQL, cloud data warehouses, BI tools, and ML frameworks


Supporting Technologies

Data & Analytics : Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost

Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP

Data Warehousing: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake

Visualization & BI: Tableau, Power BI, Looker

DevOps & Deployment: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, design tools

Our story

Enterprise Performance is about achieving maximum impact and value from investments in finance, supply chain, and IT operations requires a holistic view of key business functions from strategy through process design and technology enablement

Deloitte is a globally recognized professional services firm committed to making an impact that matters. Our Supply Chain & Network Operations practice supports clients in addressing their most critical supply chain challenges through strategic, analytical, and technology-enabled projects. We deliver end-to-end, data-driven redesign and digitization to transform key areas such as planning, sourcing & procurement, manufacturing, and logistics & distribution. Join our team in Belgium and work with clients across diverse industries as we advise, implement, and operate solutions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:


My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities


Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:


Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.


Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Role: Data Analyst
Level: Medior
Scope: Support our GTM teams with analytics, reporting, and operational insights, as well as assist with some of our internal AI-related initiatives
Language requirement: Fluent in English
Location: Ghent, Belgium, with hybrid/on-site working model


Who are we and why should you care?

Teamleader is a SaaS scale-up born in 2012 in Ghent, Belgium, and part of the Visma Group since 2022. Our mission? To make work easier, not harder , for small and medium-sized businesses.

Here’s What We Bring To The Table


Teamleader Focus : the all-in-one tool that helps small businesses optimise CRM, projects, and invoicing.
Teamleader One : the go-to e-invoicing software that self-employed pros can count on.


We’ve Also Been Growing Smarter Through Strategic Acquisitions


Teamleader Orbit (2019): helping medium-sized agencies thrive and scale.
Vectera (2022): powering seamless customer meetings.
Dexxter (2024): making financial admin a breeze for freelancers.


Curious to learn more about us, our products, and why you’ll love working at Teamleader? Check us out here .

We Are Looking for an Data Analyst to Join us

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our central RevOps, Data & AI team . In this role, you will turn data into actionable insights across the full customer funnel, from Marketing and Sales through onboarding, usage, and retention.

You will work closely with GTM teams, product stakeholders, and fellow data colleagues to deliver high impact analysis, dashboards, and data stories that influence decision making. In addition, you will contribute to the rollout of applied AI use cases by preparing high quality datasets, supporting automation, and helping translate insights into scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on, impact-driven role focused on applied analytics and AI rather than research-oriented data science.

As a Data Analyst At Teamleader, You Will


Analyze performance across the full Go-to-Market funnel, including acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and expansion
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting layers using Looker to enable self-serve insights across teams
Create clear data stories and communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations to business stakeholders
Collaborate with GTM and Product teams to define metrics, ensure reliable tracking, and evaluate experiments or initiatives
Work with structured datasets in Snowflake , including relational modeling using SQL
Support recurring analytics needs as well as ad hoc deep dives across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product
Contribute to applied AI initiatives by preparing datasets, identifying automation opportunities, and supporting insight generation workflows
Help improve data quality, documentation, and analytical best practices across the organization
Take ownership of analytics projects from scoping through delivery, in close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders


Why others chose Teamleader: we're lively, not corporate

We have the energy and boldness of a start-up and the expertise and pragmatism of a scale-up. The result: a team of both young and seasoned professionals led by supportive and approachable managers who give recognition and rewards for hard work. You’ll be working in a fast-paced tech environment with open feedback culture and room for initiatives as well as ideas. You’ll have plenty of room to apply your personality, express yourself, and impact our course of action with your insights or ideas.

On Top Of That, You’ll Get


An extensive training budget.
A hybrid working model: a pleasant mix of office and home working.
A personal tooling budget, to make working from home as comfortable as from our offices.
Daily budget-friendly in-house prepared lunch and dinner options (only in our Ghent office), as well as Friyays and numerous sport initiatives!
32 holidays on top of the standard public ones! (based on full-time employment).
Our long-lasting dedication to employee well-being, just take a look at our career page and Instagram to see how we keep the Team(leader) spirit going.


We value diversity

Our ambition is to build and sell a product that helps everyone everywhere (starting with Europe) to work smarter, so we want our team to reflect that. We believe that a diverse, inclusive working environment is crucial to realise that ambition, so we’re committed to continue to build and cherish a culture where every colleague feels welcome, appreciated and heard.

Job Requirements

You’d be a great fit for this role if you:


3–5 years of experience in a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, or Analytics role
Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of relational data modeling
Proven experience building dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear business insight s and actionable recommendations
Experience working with funnel metrics and business KPIs
Comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset and ability to work autonomously on projects


Bonus If You Have


Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Redshift)
Familiarity with GTM systems such as HubSpot or similar CRMs
Exposure to experimentation, A/B testing, or product analytics
Hands-on experience with AI-driven workflow automation tools and processes
Experience bringing analytics or automation workflows into production
Interest in AI, automation, and scalable analytics solutions
Experience in SaaS or B2B environments


Interested? Questions? Get in touch!

Title: Data analyst connectivity
Description:
Your role

“Data mining” is a trend you can’t miss these days. The use of data is becoming more and more standard in different domains like product design or decision making.

Your role is to support other teams with your data analyses skills. Your focus point will be on “connectivity” data, but the requests can be very diverse. Many of our products are connected to the cloud, most of our products have digital twins, all our designs are created in a digital environment. There are plenty of opportunities to find relations, correlations, and influences to improve our products, processes or reporting tools. The knowledge and learnings are shared with the product development teams or other stakeholders like the service division or managment

Some Examples


Could we improve the quality of our machines by standardizing on specific items that appear to be more reliable than others?
What is a typical operating regime for a certain type of machines?
Are our machines performing as expected?
Do we get a lot of safety warning due to a clogged filter from a specific supplier?
At which average outlet pressure do our machines operate at 1000m above sea level?


To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.


Master's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related technical or scientific field.
Programming in Python (PySpark) and SQL is a must, basic knowledge of other programming languages is required
Experience in cloud computing, data analysis and signal processing is required
Notion of version control system, database structures and modeling techniques
Knowledge of Matlab, Power query and PowerBI is a plus
Interest in AI and the latest trends and evolutions in data science is a plus


In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Title: Data Management Analyst
Description:
We are currently looking for a Data Management Analyst who will support the IKO companies' master data accuracy, setup, and maintenance. Ensure data integrity across the business applications, including the ERP system. Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Pricing Analyst - Regio Deerlijk




Voor een dynamisch onderneming in volle internationale groei in de as van de E17 gaat Robert Half op zoek naar een pricing analyst om de pricing filosofie mee vorm te geven.




PRICING ANALYST




Takenpakket

Je bepaalt de juiste verkoopprijs voor een heel uitgebreide catalogus aan producten en stuurt de pricing continu bij om de marge te beschermen.
Je volgt de marge op via SQL-query's en signaleert waar bijsturing nodig is.
Je bereidt pricing-input voor bij klantendeals, in nauw overleg met sales.
Je werkt mee aan een nieuwe pricingfilosofie gebaseerd op consistentie, eerlijkheid en transparantie.
Je onderhoudt en ontwikkelt Power BI-dashboards die het salesteam ondersteunen.
Je volgt aflopende vaste prijsafspraken op en signaleert dit tijdig aan sales.
Je verwerkt nieuwe leveranciersprijzen in het ERP-systeem.




Profiel

Min. Bachelor, bij voorkeur in een analytische of business-gerichte richting.
Min. 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring in pricing, purchasing of sales analytics, bij voorkeur in een B2B-omgeving.
Sterke, gevorderde Excel-skills; ervaring met macro's of automatisering is een plus.
Je schrijft vlot eigen SQL-query's om data op te vragen.
Kennis van Power BI is een troef, of de bereidheid om dit snel te leren.
Scherp analytisch inzicht en oog voor detail.
Vloeiend in Nederlands & Engels als aparte bullet.




Aanbod

Je komt terecht in een groeiend, internationaal bedrijf waar jouw pricing-beslissingen een directe impact hebben op de winstgevendheid en de business. De burelen zijn vlot bereikbaar vanuit de ruime regio. Je krijgt een competitief salaris tussen de €3000 en €4500 afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, aangevuld met een aantrekkelijk voordelenpakket: maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, fietsleaseplan, 26 verlofdagen vrij te kiezen, flexibele uren, 1 dag telewerk per week na je inwerkperiode, en geen collectieve sluiting.




Heb je interesse in deze functie? Solliciteer nu!

Data Engineer / Data Visualization Analyst H/F

C'est votre mission

Vous êtes passionné par la Data, la visualisation de données et le secteur de l'énergie ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant que Data Engineer / Data Visualization Analyst, vous contribuerez à l'amélioration de la gestion des données, à la création de visualisations et au développement d'outils d'analyse pour les études liées au marché de l'électricité.

Build Side


Améliorer les processus de gestion des données (Data Warehouse, Data Pipelines…)
Concevoir et développer des outils d'analyse en Python pour exploiter les données issues des simulations

Consolider les données historiques dans un Data Warehouse
Participer au développement d'interfaces entre les différents outils Data


Run Side


Explorer et analyser les données issues des simulations
Comparer les résultats des différentes études et les données historiques à l'aide de visualisations
Présenter les visualisations aux parties prenantes et les faire évoluer selon les retours

Analyser les résultats des simulations afin d'identifier les tendances et anomalies
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils et des méthodes de visualisation des données

Python

Traitement et analyse de données
Visualisation de données

ANTARES ou autre outil de simulation de marché

Expérience en simulations de marché électrique

Elia Is Therefore Looking For The Support Of a Specialized Service With Expert Knowledge On Data Analysis (data Mining, Data Gathering/processing (in VBA, Excel, R/Python), Data Visualization) And Energy Systems Scenarios. The Consultant Will Help To Perform Different Tasks In Different Projects Within The SMA Team


Use, and when possible improve, data management processes at SMA.
Contribute, and when possible improve, data collection processes and definition – creation of scenarios and model building datasets.
Support the model building, including quality checks on the built models.
Support on the impact assessment of (some parts of ) the model building (e.g. the demand assumptions, renewables assumptions, flexibility and storage assumptions..) as well as quality checks on the models and results after simulations.


Example of tasks

A non-exhaustive list of tasks (and description) is given below:


Consolidate historical data into an model input data set.
Collect projection scenarios from EU countries, and challenge the data, ensure those are in line with defined storylines;
Create & review tools in R/Python/VBA/Excel in order to input/change different parameters or data items in the model or simulation ANTARES tool;
Be able to use and improve, create visualisations of the outputs of simulations (in R, Power BI, Qgis, …)
Critically analyze results of algorithms, assist in the identification of key trends
Data engineering and interfaces between tools
Other tasks (not yet defined)


Requirements

Hard skills


R or Python


(must have)


R is extensively used in existing tools at SMA. However new tools are rather developed now in Python. Hence, proficiency in one of the two is a must, but experience with both is a plus.


Excel

(‘must have’)

and VBA

(‘nice to have’)


Excel and VBA are used to conduct analyses or as interface for R/python scripts. It is one of the ways the team explores data (up to a certain size). Many of the databases used by SMA are stored in Excel format.


ANTARES (mainly the input/output interface but also a general knowledge of economic dispatch tool is a

‘nice to have’


ANTARES is an economic dispatch tool developed by RTE, the French TSO. In the application’s core is an economic dispatch tool for the electricity market. Antares allows to simulate the electricity market on an hourly basis.
The tool needs to be fed with input data and given the large quantity of data generated by the simulator (depending on the study, more than 10 GB per simulation), several scripts and spreadsheets were developed to input, retrieve data and analyse it.
Any experience with market simulations can be valued here.


Soft Skills


Medior profile: 3 yrs experience minimum.
You have knowledge of and strong interest in the energy market;
You are able to work independently and in a team;
You have an analytical and innovative mind;
Fluent level of Dutch and/or French and English is required.
