Title: Junior Data Analyst
HTML:
We are looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join us and reinforce our expanding Data Analytics team in our Ghent or Brussels office! The successful candidate will support our audit teams with cutting-edge automated solutions, contributing to delivering data analytics services to our clients and helping to shape the future of our audit.

Key Responsibilities

  • You will collaborate with audit teams to build core audit expertise, with a focus on expanding insights through data analytics;
  • You will assist with ETL processes:
  • Collect or extract data from various sources (e.g. client’s databases);
  • Perform data cleaning, if needed;
  • Conduct reconciliation exercises and validations;
  • Transform and remap data according to data requirements;
  • Review data consistency and quality, and ensure proper formatting in Forvis Mazars’ data systems.
  • You will leverage gathered data for process mining, data mining, outlier identification, and data validation using AI-driven solutions;
  • You will conduct analysis, create audit reports and interpret results;
  • You will assist in the development of audit reports and dashboards to provide actionable insights;
  • You will collaborate with team members to identify trends and patterns in data.

About You

  • You have a Master’s degree in Business Engineering or any related field, with a specialisation in Data Analytics;
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
  • You have an interest in the financial sector and sustainability data;
  • You have experience with SQL, Python or other data analysis tools;
  • You are strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel;
  • You are able to design and interpret flowcharts;
  • You are familiar with data visualization tools such as Power BI;
  • You are native in Dutch and/or French, with a strong knowledge of English;
  • You are eager to learn and grow in the data analysis field;
  • You are familiar with basic accounting principles;
  • You have excellent attention to detail and a focus on quality, even when performing repetitive tasks;
  • You are a creative thinker with an “out-of-the-box” mindset;
  • You have good communication skills, both written and verbal.

Problems do not exist, only solutions!

Our Offer

  • Internal training sessions combined with an on-the-job training;
  • A springboard to launch you career and create significant growth opportunities;
  • A young, positive and flexible working environment where personal development and a healthy work-life balance are encouraged;
  • A competitive salary with a benefit package including a company car with fuel card/mobility budget, insurances, net allowances, and much more!

Company description

Forvis Mazars Group SC is an independent member of Forvis Mazars Global, a leading global professional services network.

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services.

Title: Data Analyst Senior (H/F)
Description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y !


Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer
Curieux, poser des questions est votre seconde nature
Analytique, vous avez une âme d’enquêteur et les énigmes n’ont aucun secret pour vous


Description Du Poste

Vous serez intégré(e) dans une équipe de consultants innovants et motivés, composée de Business Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers spécialisés sur les problématiques Data Analytics. À ce titre, vous interviendrez de façon opérationnelle sur des missions de conseil autour des sujets de transformation Data Analytics, de retraitement et modélisation de données et de représentation visuelle de la donnée pour adresser des problématiques métiers.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


Comprendre les problématiques métier,
Collecter et traiter les données en vue de l'analyse, incluant notamment la création de variables agrégées et complémentaires aux données brutes,
Automatiser et d’industrialiser les retraitements effectués sur les données,
Représenter les résultats dans un outil de restitution visuelle de façon ergonomique et intuitive,
Restituer les analyses au client notamment pas la création d’indicateurs pertinents pour les questions stratégiques des entreprises


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 5 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :


Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils et méthodologies de Data Analytics, incluant notamment des bases techniques (modèles de données, langage SQL, …) mais également méthodologiques,
Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie d'Excel et maitrisez les langages statistiques tels que R, Python ou SAS,
Une connaissance d'un logiciel ou langage dédié à la Data Visualization (Tableau, Qliksense ou Qlickview, Microsoft Power BI…) ainsi que des compétences en automatisation (VBA par exemple) seraient un plus.


PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT


Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique
Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution
Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence


Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous !

PACKAGE SALARIAL

Chez Extia Belgique IT, la transparence fait partie intégrante de l'expérience positive, voici un aperçu des éléments de package salarial dont peuvent profiter nos collaborateurs, sous réserve d'éligibilité

👛 Voiture de société ou budget mobilité ✨ Chèques repas & Ecocheque 🎁 Assurance groupe 🎉 Frais de représentation 📈 Plan cafétéria / Flex Income Plan 🚀 Primes d'apport d'affaire, de cooptation et de formation 🌍 20 jours de congés légaux + 12 jours de récupération

Ces informations sont communiquées à titre indicatif et seront abordées plus en détails lors du processus de recrutement.

LES PETITS PLUS

🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en Belgique ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

Title: Power BI Specialist / Data Analyst – GJA 16
Description:
Role Overview

As a Power BI Specialist / Functional Data Analyst at ING, you will play a key role in turning data made available to you into clear, reliable and actionable business insights. Your work will help teams, management and front-office stakeholders make faster, smarter and better-informed decisions.

In This Role, You Will


Translate business questions into relevant views, datasets and data products that make insights easy to access and use.
Maintain, design and optimize Power BI data models to deliver high-performing, scalable and trusted reporting solutions for management and front-office teams.
Develop, automate and enhance Power BI dashboards, ensuring that available data is transformed into meaningful insights that support performance steering, prioritization and decision-making.
Create compelling visualizations and narratives that translate complex data into clear, intuitive and business-relevant stories.


Key Responsibilities

Data Modeling and Collaboration:


Partner with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, clarify problem statements and define how available data should be transformed, enriched and presented for maximum impact.
Design and optimize Power BI data models that are robust, performant and intuitive, enabling advanced features such as hierarchical filtering, drill-down analysis and multi-level organizational structures.


Reporting And Automation


Contribute to the development of a Power BI Center of Expertise by promoting best practices in dashboard design, data modeling, performance optimization and governance.
Develop and automate the underlying processes required for recurring reports, including weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reporting cycles.
Build interactive dashboards and reports that deliver actionable insights, highlight key trends and enable users to explore the data independently.


As a Power BI Specialist / Functional Data Analyst, you should have the following qualifications and competences:

Qualifications


Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or alike, and/or equivalent experience of 5 years.
Minimum 5 years relevant experience in data analytics
Experienced in SQL.
Strong expertise in Power BI data modeling, advanced DAX, report performance optimization and dashboard development.
Advanced experience in developing, automating and maintaining reporting solutions using Power BI.
Experience with tools such as SAS is a plus
Experience in analytical work with large datasets and relational databases.


Core Competencies


To be customer driven and focused, loving to collaborate with different people.
An entrepreneurial attitude – taking initiative and making things happen.
Be analytical and insight-driven: curious about banking and business performance, able to identify patterns in data and translate them into concise, relevant conclusions.
Open to learn other dashboarding solutions
Banking knowledge is a plus
Be able to influence and convince peers and stakeholders by clearly explaining analytical results, business implications and recommended actions.
Fluent in English and Dutch or French

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
WHAT IS CREAM ALL ABOUT?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency…

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

• 1/3 Personal development • 1/3 Collective intelligence • 1/3 Intrapreneurship • Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues




YOUR FUTURE PROJECTS :

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be :

Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team
Define the business specifications for BI needs
Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined
Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects
Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture
Collaborate with the development team




WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM OUR CONSULTANT ?

You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience
You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis
You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)
You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills
You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment
You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach
You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player
You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset
You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client’s request




WHY SHOULD YOU TASTE THE LIME FLAVOR ?

A strong learning environment: tribes, training budget
Career follow-up with dedicated Business Managers and an associate plan
Attractive benefits package (mobility plan, meal vouchers, insurances,...)
Hybrid working model: client working, home working & Cream working
Strong CSR commitments, with recognized labels in environmental responsibility and diversity & inclusion.
A consulting company of around 200 Creamers, located in the center of Brussels




Our recruitment process is clear and structured, with three steps and feedback throughout.

Cream Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. If you need any specific accommodation to fully participate in the recruitment process or the interview, please let us know.

Think this role is a match? Apply and let’s talk, or explore our other opportunities at Cream.

Title: Data Integratie & Analytics specialist
Description:
Het vertrouwen dat je wil. Zonder erom te moeten vragen.

Werken bij Moore, da’s business as unusual. 

Als Data Integratie & Analytics Specialist in Antwerpen/Brussel speel je een cruciale rol: je verbindt applicaties, stroomlijnt datastromen en vertaalt complexe informatie naar heldere inzichten. Zo help je onze teams om betere beslissingen te nemen en werk je mee aan een performant, toekomstbestendig datalandschap.

Ben jij iemand die graag techniek, analyse en business combineert? Dan zit je hier helemaal goed.

Hoe ziet jouw job eruit?

Je focust op slimme data-integratie


Je ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt data‑ en applicatie‑integraties in easymorph.
Je creëert betrouwbare dataflows tussen ERP, CRM, BI en externe systemen.
Je vertaalt businessnoden naar functionele en technische analyses.
Je staat in voor datamapping, transformaties en kwaliteitscontroles.
Je monitort integraties en zorgt voor duidelijke documentatie.
Je schakelt vlot met business stakeholders, IT-collega’s en externe partners.


Je bouwt mee aan onze analytics‑omgeving


Je ontwikkelt en beheert schaalbare datapipelines en ETL-processen in Azure Databricks.
Je zorgt voor monitoring, troubleshooting en structurele verbeteringen.
Je creëert overzichtelijke dashboards en rapporten in Power BI.
Je adviseert teams rond datakwaliteit, governance en slim datagebruik.


Word jij onze nieuwe companion?

Technische vaardigheden die het verschil maken


Ervaring met ETL/ELT-processen
Kennis van API-integraties (REST/SOAP), XML/JSON
Sterke SQL‑skills en inzicht in data-engineeringprincipes
Databricks (SQL, Python, Delta Lake, Spark, Unity Catalog)
Azure Data Factory & Azure Data Lake Storage
Power BI (DAX, datamodellen, RLS, dashboarddesign)
Inzicht in ERP- en CRM‑omgevingen
Ervaring met Azure of andere cloudplatformen


Jouw persoonlijkheid


Je bent analytisch en oplossingsgericht.
Je communiceert helder, zowel met business als IT.
Je bent leergierig en werkt graag samen.
Je neemt initiatief en blijft kritisch voor datakwaliteit.


Achtergrond


Bachelor of Master in Informatica, Data Science, Handelsingenieur of gelijkwaardig


Minstens 5 jaar relevante ervaring in data-integratie en/of data-engineering

Het vertrouwen dat je wil. Zonder erom te moeten vragen. Werken bij Moore, da’s business as unusual. 
Ondernemen, Innoveren en Delen zijn onze kernwaarden. Ze vormen de rode draad in alles wat we doen, niet alleen voor onze klanten, maar ook voor onze medewerkers.

Title: BE - BI Consultant
Description:
Overview

Who are we?

CBTW is a global tech solutions company.

We empower businesses with tailored tech and business solutions that drive innovation and sustainable growth.

With over 2 500 experts across 21 countries, we deliver results through flexible engagement models like: whether augmenting teams, managing complex projects, or building long-term operations.

Thanks to our 5 service lines, we specialize in:


AI & Data Platforms,
Cloud & Enterprise Platforms,
Cybersecurity,
Software Engineering,
Strategy, Product & Transformation.


More info on our website: https://cbtw.tech/

What service line will you be part of?

As a B.I. Consultant, you will join our AI & Data Platforms expertise.

AI & Data Platforms is CBTW's service line dedicated to supporting organizations in leveraging their data and fulfilling their AI ambitions to achieve tangible results. We focus on adoption and measurable impact from day one, combining our comprehensive, end-to-end expertise with our ecosystem of leading partners such as SAS, Snowflake, Microsoft and Databricks.

Our clients rely on us to support with:


Data Platform modernisation, migration and optimisation
AI-driven Business Insights & Customer Analytics
Cutting-edge GenAI products & Agentic AI automation
Unified Data Platform & Cloud Infrastructure
Data & AI Governance
BI & Analytics for business teams


Responsibilities

What is your role?

You will be part of a journey where you will have two impacts: a client impact and an internal impact . For the internal impact, based on your skills and time, you will be joining our internal data communit y at CBTW, to share knowledge and best practices . For the client impact , t asks can vary depending on the client and the project, but as a BI Consultant, you will mainly :


Create insightful information and help managers make better data-driven decisions
Be able to participate from A to Z on the BI chain: identify , collect, integrate, analyze data & present reports
Develop ETL, do the modelization of data warehouses and build reports for the business


Qualifications

What is your profile?

You :


Have at least a bachelor's degree
Have at least 3 years of experience on a similar project
Speak fluently French or Dutch and English
Have an hands-on experience with tools and technologies such as SQL, Oracle, Informatica, Microsoft (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS), Talend, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, IBM ( Datastage , Cognos), Kimball, DataVault, SAP…
Will be an outstanding candidate if you share our values: Positive Thinking, Collaboration, Evolution & Commitment.


What are we offering?

EVOLUTION:


A career development expert will follow up on your professional path within the company and support you in shaping and growing your career,
Catalogue with a wide variety of trainings for hard and soft skills, private language classes, unlimited access to an E-learning platform (Udemy, Code Academy... ) and possibility to get certified every year,
Training days credits.


COLLABORATION:


You will join a community of [job title] experts where colleagues support each other on projects, share knowledge through workshops and events to keep learning and evolving, and build international connections, while also enjoying great moments and drinks together,
Participate in internal projects to innovate and develop our solutions portfolio,
Join one of our collectives (Wellness, Agile, RSE, Gaming ...) and share your interests with other positive thinkers,
You’ll also enjoy several unforgettable company parties throughout the year. Events that CBTW has truly mastered the art of organizing.


ON TOP OF THAT:


We offer a competitive salary with a flexible mobility package that allows you to choose options such as having mobility benefits (electric cars, electric bikes, public transportation subscription).


Your next adventure starts at CBTW!

Do you see a match? We would love to see your application coming in! 😉

Title: Data and Control Analyst
Description:
Job description:



Department  

The Corporate Planning division, located in Brussels, consists of several departments: The corporate planning department in charge of Group Controlling & Daikin Europe controlling, the Business Analytics department, the Internal controls & J-Sox department, and Corporate Communications department. 

The division is responsible for drilling down the strategy into annual budgets and realizing the group targets. This is done in cooperation with all sales and manufacturing entities, as well as with other departments in Daikin Europe. As a backbone for group-wide reporting, the department takes care of the management of the sales-, margin-, and pricing data, as well as collecting and reporting market intelligence.  

Our mission is to safeguard and manage profitability, via periodic reporting to top-management, close follow-up and by proposing countermeasure actions.  

Furthermore, the division is responsible for the development and implementation of corporate governance and internal controls in the group (e.g. J-SOx and system access). 

 

The vacancy is in the Business Analytics department. 

About the job - Data and Control Analyst 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and improvement-focused Senior Data & Control Analyst to join our project team at Daikin EMEA HQ in Brussels. 

In this role, you will ensure and develop the framework of our reporting environment within our IT system landscape, participating and leading roll-outs, standardisation and improvement projects across the entire Daikin EMEA Group. 

You will act as the bridge between business and IT by collaborating with various stakeholders, including senior management, business controllers, and IT analysts in Daikin HQ and Affiliate companies of the EMEA group. 

 

Function 

You will be involved in SAP roll-outs at our daughter companies. You will propose and implement changes to improve the controlling function. Core focus to be to promote and support process improvement and standardisation initiatives across Daikin Europe HQ and its entities. 
You will discuss changes requested by the business and, together with IT, translate these into SAP solutions. 
You will be involved in the roll-out of managerial reporting across different business streams and software packages at our daughter companies. During these projects, you will focus mainly on the interface with SAP for controlling functionalities, as well as the reporting track in Power BI to ensure data lineage. 
You will work with a wide range of stakeholders, each with different requirements. You are able to set priorities, manage expectations and communicate accordingly.  
You will lead these initiatives end-to-end as project owner — planning, coordinating and steering cross-functional projects across business, IT and finance, keeping multiple workstreams on track and delivering on time. 
You will drive organisation and change management to ensure adoption of new processes and systems, guiding stakeholders through the transition and embedding new ways of working. 
You will drive conceptual implementations together with the Global Process Owner (GPO) across the organisation, including end-to-end modelling within SAP, presenting and defending it to management and a broad audience, and actively participating in its implementation. 
You will own and maintain core documentation and governance over the fundamentals of the controlling function. 
You will drive the implementation of the rebates module across Daikin entities. 

 



Profile description:



 

Your profile 

You have a Master's degree in business economics, finance or controlling. 
You already have extended experience in a similar role as controller or SAP key-user, or extended experience in an analytical position. 
You have depth experience of S/4HANA (SD, FI and CO), ideally including exposure to migration or rollout projects. 
You have experience with testing and UAT for new SAP processes, system changes, or implementation projects. 
You have experience with SAP reporting tools (e.g. FAGLL03H) to build and analyse financial and management reporting. 
You bring strong project management skills — you plan, organise and steer projects to completion, and are comfortable coordinating stakeholders and workstreams across functions independently. 
You have experience with, or a strong affinity for, change management — driving adoption and helping people through process and system change. 
You are prepared to travel abroad (15% of your time) and/or to the Oostkamp office (Accounting & IT) when projects or meetings require this. 
You work accurately, with the ability to dig into the details without losing the helicopter view. 
You have experience working in a multi-company environment, coordinating across different affiliates. 
You can create process documentation and train end users, ensuring knowledge transfer and adoption across the organisation. 
You possess excellent analytical skills and demonstrate strong communication and organisational skills. 
You are a team player, but you are also able to work independently. 
You are result-driven with a strong focus on improvement. 

 



We offer:



 

 

What we offer 

At Daikin, you can count on a varied job with an international market leader that stimulates its people to grow and to work together. We offer you an open ended contract. You will be given extensive training and will be well supported from the start. The position carries a competitive salary and a package of extra-legal benefits.  This function offers an excellent stepping stone to take on more responsibilities in a planning-oriented function or a detachment abroad at one of our EMEA affiliates.  

Daikin Europe is a subsidiary of Daikin Industries Ltd. and the leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. The company designs, manufactures and brings to market a broad portfolio of equipment, as well as tailor-made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). To date, Daikin EMEA has over 12 000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 12 major manufacturing facilities based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Austria, and the UK. Our aim is to drive sustainable and effective solutions, sparking a good climate for the generations to come. And all this can only be achieved because of our People. 

 

Good climate starts with people 
Our employees are the beating heart of our company. At Daikin, you get to work in a positive environment backed by trust, creativity and continuous improvement. Together, we create our top-quality solutions by empowering talented teams. You will get plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. We are deeply committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that reflects the communities we serve. Good climate starts with people.



callebaut.k@bxl.daikineurope.com

Title: Functional Data Analyst Consultant - Data Modeling & Business Process Optimization | FR/NL and EN
Description:
Functional Data Analyst Consultant at Orange Business

Permanent contract

FR or NL + EN




Ever wondered what it feels like to be at the cutting edge of digital innovation? Our Digital & Data team at Orange Business is a dynamic community of expert consultants revolutionizing Customer Experience, Data, and AI across various sectors, including retail, finance, manufacturing, life sciences, and public services.




We have a significant international presence, with 20% of our activity extending beyond Belgium, and this number continues to grow. In this role, you will act as a key member of the dynamic Functional Data Architecture Consulting team with 12 enthusiastic consultants. You’ll dive into exciting data and functional analysis missions across diverse and impactful projects.




Acting as a bridge between business and data teams, you will analyze business needs, define and validate data models, and ensure data usage and dashboards are aligned with real business processes and KPIs.




We value people who are proactive on every level, deliver exceptional results, work well with others, and make a clear impact on our clients and our business. If you love collaborating, learning, sharing your expertise, and being recognized for your achievements, you’ll fit right in with our team.




Check out some of our ongoing projects:

Rebuilding the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Data Platform (CDP) systems in the aviation industry.
Refactoring the Fund Management application in a financial institution by modernizing data storage for improved efficiency and enhancing data visualization.
Data Management projects in retail, transport, and financial sectors.




Your key areas of responsibility as a Functional Data Analyst Consultant:

Cover data modeling, data process improvement, data analysis, and data management within assigned projects.
Translate business requirements into clear functional data specifications.
Define, design, and validate data models in collaboration with technical teams.
Optimize dashboards, KPIs, and data usage from a business perspective.
Ensure data consistency across reports, tools, and domains.
Building documentation and testing implementations of the innovative solutions.
Stakeholder management: Meeting and managing customer needs and expectations.
Act as a trusted consultant, advising clients on data structures, usage, and best practices to meet their business objectives.




What this role is not:

You are not expected to build data pipelines or design technical architectures.
You are not responsible for complex SQL, ETL development, or coding-heavy tasks.
You influence and validate data structures rather than implementing them.




Who you are:

Your interest & soft skills

A good affinity with and interest in technological solutions, with the capability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Effectively operate in workshop and interview contexts.
Autonomous and solutions oriented.
Dynamic team player.
Strong communication and presentation skills in French and/or Dutch + English.




Your technical experience

Title: CRO Specialist
Description:
Wat je gaat doen
Zie jij overal kansen om websites te verbeteren en kun je dat nog eens met data staven ook? Perfect! Als CRO Specialist bij iO maak je met jouw datagedreven optimalisaties écht impact op de conversies van websites en portalen. Jij vormt de brug tussen onze marketeers en developers en geeft hen de juiste input om mee aan de slag te gaan.

Op basis van jouw aanbevelingen uit verschillende onderzoeksmethodes, zet je proactief initiatieven op die de gebruikservaring en conversies een boost geven.

Jouw dagelijkse uitdagingen:

Van snelle audits tot diepgaande analyses: Je duikt in de data voor een brede waaier aan klanten. Je voert CRO-analyses en audits uit, brengt de pijnpunten in de customer journey bloot en vertaalt je inzichten naar concrete, impactvolle aanbevelingen.
Diepgaande optimalisatietrajecten: Je bijt je vast in complexe optimalisatieprogramma's. Hierin focus je toegewijd op het continu verbeteren van de gebruikerservaring en het maximaliseren van conversies


Dit alles doe je natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met een team van data- en analytics specialisten, UX-designers, marketeers en strategen. Je voert A/B-tests uit, analyseert de resultaten en verwerkt je bevindingen in professionele presentaties. Jouw inzichten giet je in overtuigende verhalen waarmee je zowel klanten als collega’s inspireert en aanzet tot actie.

Bij iO staan we nooit stil. We investeren volop in jouw technische kennis en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Want wij weten als geen ander: samen staan we sterker.

Daarom ben jij de perfecte CRO Specialist

Je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen, bent van nature nieuwsgierig, werkt nauwkeurig en hebt een proactieve houding
Online personalisatietools zoals VWO, Spotler, Adobe of Blueconic hebben voor jou geen geheimen
Je bent een krak in het toepassen van CRO-principes (zoals Cialdini en andere overtuigingstechnieken) op diverse businessmodellen (B2B, B2C, e-commerce)
Met minstens 2 jaar ervaring op de teller weet jij perfect hoe je een succesvol optimalisatieplan opstelt en uitvoert
Je vindt moeiteloos je weg in tools als Clarity en Hotjar
Complexe data uit Google Looker Studio, Google Analytics en PowerBI zet jij om in overtuigende en heldere inzichten
Je hebt ervaring met HTML en CSS. Kennis van JavaScript is een dikke plus!
Je weet hoe je duidelijke en overtuigende presentaties maakt en kunt je bevindingen uitstekend onderbouwen


Dit krijg jij van ons

32 vakantiedagen
Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek heb je 20 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen.

Mobiliteit & eindejaarspremie
Na 6 maanden in dienst kun je bij iO rekenen op een eindejaarspremie. En op mobiliteitsvlak bieden we verschillende mogelijkheden, passend bij jouw job of voorkeur.

Hospitalisatieverzekering
Heb je eens iets voor? Dan is extra stress rond kosten het laatste wat je kunt gebruiken. Iedereen geniet bij ons van een hospitalisatieverzekering bij Axa.

Hybride werken
Een goede werk-privébalans is essentieel. Samen met je team maak je afspraken over wanneer én waar je werkt.

Gezonde snacks & lunch
Op elke iO campus pak je de hele dag een gezond tussendoortje en lunch je voor een kleine vergoeding gezond én gevarieerd.

Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget
Je krijgt elk jaar € 3.000,- om jezelf te ontwikkelen, in je vak of als persoon, met trainingen, events of cursussen.

Samen vieren
Als we iets te vieren hebben, dan doen we het goed! Het partyteam op jouw campus staat op z'n tijd dan ook garant voor de leukste (thema)feestjes.

Title: Design & Utilization - Senior Data Analyst
Description:
bpost strives to create an inclusive environment with challenging projects and inspiring collaborations. With our colleagues at the heart of our organisation, we believe in careers rather than jobs. As part of the international group bnode, bpost has transitioned from the Belgian postal operator to a regional and digital expert in parcel size logistics. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We foster a culture that supports diversity, inclusion and career growth, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to thrive and succeedWhat will you do?

Bnode strives to create an inclusive environment with challenging projects and inspiring collaborations. With our employees at the heart of our organization, we don’t believe in jobs, we believe in careers. We're now looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will make us move.

Your mission

The Out of Home (OOH) team within bpost is responsible for all manned and unmanned points within bpost, excluding post offices. This includes parcel points, postal points and parcel lockers. Currently bpost has around 2,500 parcel lockers and this network represents a key strategic pillar.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will play a key role in driving data initiatives, building dashboards, delivering actionable insights and supporting strategic decision-making across the business.

Reporting


Take full ownership of end-to-end dashboard development: from data collection and transformation to data modelling and visualization (PowerBI), including building and maintaining Python scripts for data processing, simulation and optimization
Design, build and maintain robust data model to ensure scalable and business-ready reportings
Develop a deep understanding of system architecture and data dependencies across operational and IT environments
Act as a bridge between business and IT teams, translating business needs into technical/data requirements, and interact effectively with Central Data Team


Data analysis and profitability insights


Perform in-depth analyses on the usage of lockers, also focusing on how they contribute to profitability. You ensure clear, data-driven insights that improve capacity usage and operational performance in the long term
Prepare reports summarizing financial and operational performance, presenting key KPIs for Management
Monitor and analyze real-time data for lockers and manned points, with recommendations for adjustments and improvements


Data Modeling & Governance


Contribute to the definition and implementation of a structured and scalable data model for OOH activities
Identify data inconsistencies and actively participate in improving overall data quality
Define, implement and monitor data quality (DQ) rules in collaboration with IT and the Central Data Team
Clarify KPI definitions and ensure alignment between business and reporting logic
Support the progressive transition from manual Excel-based processes to more automated and reliable data solutions


Capacity forecasting and optimization


Collaborate with the team to make data-driven forecasts about capacity needs based on historical data, seasonal trends, and expected peak moments
Develop strategies for optimal use of lockers and manned points, focusing on balancing customer satisfaction and costs


Who are you?


University degree
Mandatory: advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerBi and Python
At least 5 years of relevant work experience in data analytics, business intelligence or any related analytical role
Excellent command of English, proficiency in Dutch and/or French is a plus
Strong affinity with capacity planning and demand forecasting techniques
Preferred: experience or strong affinity with Capacity Management/Yield Management
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
Proactive attitude and great problem-solving abilities
Knowledge of data modeling principles
Experience in data quality management and governance practices
Ability to work in low-maturity data environments and structure data processes


What do we offer?

Like a Long-awaited Parcel, We Want To Make You Feel Welcome And Valued. Our Offer Includes a Competitive Monthly Salary, That Goes Without Saying. On Top Of That, You Can Count On


Meal vouchers of €8 per working day
Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances
A phone subscription, including 25GB data
A flexible renumeration plan, which allows you to customize your own benefits. A company car, bike leasing, public transportation, extra days off,... the choice is yours
Possibility to enter the Federal Mobility plan
Work/life balance, thanks to flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off
An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay
Many benefits from more than 100 bpost-partners

Description:
Data Architect / Business Analyst

Bridge351 is looking for a Data Architect / Business Analyst to join a strategic project for the Comisión Europea.

This role sits at the core of an enterprise data transformation initiative, focused on designing the target Data Warehouse and Lakehouse architecture (Kimball/Inmon methodologies, Microsoft Fabric) and rationalising the current Data Hub/Data Warehouse landscape, complemented by business analysis and stakeholder facilitation activities.

Knowledge and skills:

Data Architecture and Data Modelling (core focus)


Minimum 7 years of experience in enterprise data architecture, data modelling and data warehouse design.
Strong expertise in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling.
Proven experience designing enterprise Data Warehouse solutions.
Strong knowledge of Kimball dimensional modelling methodologies, including star schemas, fact and dimension modelling, conformed dimensions and data marts.
Good knowledge of Inmon Corporate Information Factory (CIF) principles and enterprise data warehouse architecture.
Experience designing enterprise information models and business data models.

Title: Senior Data Analyst Consultant
Description:
Mission Overview

About the job Senior Data Analyst Consultant

The Data Analyst position is a consultancy mission at the client site, representing Keystone Solutions. As a Keystone Solutions consultant, you will be hired to deliver high-impact data solutions for AML processes, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and scalability. You will bridge the gap between data providers (IT, Data Hub, Operations) and data consumers (AML/Compliance teams), aligning technical solutions with business needs while upholding strict data governance and quality standards.

Responsibilities


Coordinate input from IT, Data Hub, Compliance, and Operations, ensuring alignment through structured documentation, workshops, and clear communication.
Translate complex business requirements into actionable data solutions, balancing technical feasibility with regulatory and operational needs.
Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, including role definitions, quality rules, and access protocols, in collaboration with data providers and consumers.
Monitor, refine, and escalate data quality issues proactively, ensuring long-term integrity of AML-related datasets (e.g., Customer/Account/Transaction data).
Define and document business and technical rules for data integration, ensuring traceability and compliance.
Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, including mainframe-based data points (willingness to explore raw data is essential).
Analyze AML Transaction Monitoring data, identifying patterns, gaps, or anomalies that impact compliance or operational efficiency.
Design logical and physical data models (e.g., data warehouses, datamarts) optimized for AML reporting and analytics.
Develop and industrialize data pipelines, ensuring seamless flow and accessibility across the enterprise.
Prototype solutions to validate business requirements and refine designs based on feedback.
Streamline data workflows to maximize reusability and efficiency, reducing redundancy and manual interventions.
Advocate for best practices in data security, architecture, and compliance, aligning with IT and risk management standards.


Language Requirements


Fluent in Dutch, French, and English.


Education


Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (statistics, mathematics, engineering) or substantial knowledge of analytics.


Telework


Expectation: 50% on site & 50% homeworking.


Required Experience / Knowledge


At least 5 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics.


Technical Experience


2–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, with a focus on AML processes or financial crime prevention.
Proficiency in SQL and data modeling tools (e.g., PowerDesigner or equivalent).
Experience with reporting/dashboard tools (Tableau, BO, SAS, etc.).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (JIRA, Agile Central) is preferable.


Business Experience


Deep understanding of banking data, particularly AML Transaction Monitoring data (customer, account, transaction attributes).
Proven ability to capture, document, and manage functional/non-functional requirements for data solutions.
Knowledge of data security, IT architecture, and financial services operations.
Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks, including rule definition, monitoring, and issue escalation.
Able to coordinate input from multiple stakeholders through structured documentation, workshops, and clear communication (Project Management skills).


Soft Skills


Proactive and entrepreneurial mindset—able to drive initiatives independently while collaborating across teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a quality-focused approach.
Excellent communication to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability and eagerness to learn, with the ability to connect strategic goals to operational execution.


Keystone Solutions Advantages


As a consultant, you will work on-site and embody the Keystone Solutions identity.
Experience dynamic projects and diverse challenges across various client environments.
Accelerate your professional development and broaden your learning through turbo-charged learning opportunities.
Skyrocket your ambition with a clear commitment to career growth within the Keystone Solutions framework.
Bring core values as a “K-Stone” to every engagement, ensuring excellence and integrity in all missions.


If you are ready to tackle technical and strategic challenges in a dynamic consultancy environment, apply today at Keystone Solutions Career Portal.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies


Experience building scalable data applications using Apache Spark, with proficiency in Scala preferred and Python also acceptable
Hands-on experience working with Databricks in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)
Good understanding of distributed computing, data partitioning, and performance optimisation
Experience working with modern data formats such as Parquet, Delta Lake, and JSON
Strong SQL skills for data transformation and querying
Understanding of graph data structures, clustering techniques, and similarity approaches
Familiarity with statistical methods such as TF-IDF and similarity metrics
Proficiency with version control and build tools including Git, Gradle, Maven, or SBT
Awareness of code quality, maintainability, and testing practices using frameworks such as ScalaTest or JUnit
Experience contributing to testing approaches including unit and integration testing
Ability to use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and support development tasks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams
Willingness to learn new technologies and develop engineering expertise


Education


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Equivalent practical experience will also be considered


Responsibilities

Support the design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and data processing solutions within a scalable data engineering environment


Support the design and development of Spark-based data pipelines for processing large volumes of data
Implement parsing, normalisation, and standardisation logic across datasets
Assist in developing graph-based analytics and entity resolution workflows
Build and maintain ETL workflows ingesting data from sources such as Delta Lake, Parquet, and S3
Contribute to data quality checks, validation, and incremental processing approaches
Write and maintain unit and integration tests to support reliability
Support monitoring and troubleshooting of data pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Data Science, and Engineering
Document data flows and technical solutions
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices


About The Team

Join our Data Engineering team, responsible for building scalable data pipelines across Change Data Capture, Entity Resolution, and Data Mastering

You will work on large-scale data challenges in a collaborative environment, contributing to high-quality data solutions and developing your technical capabilities.The team is embracing a more AI-enabled way of working, with a focus on automation, insight generation, and continuous innovation

Analyze the current Data Warehouse and Data Hub from both a business and data perspective (processes, information flows, "As-Is" architecture).
Define the future ("To-Be") enterprise data model and the target Data Warehouse/Lakehouse architecture.
Design dimensional models (Kimball) and/or Corporate Information Factory (Inmon), star schemas, conformed dimensions, and data marts.
Define the Lakehouse architecture in Microsoft Fabric, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers on Delta Lake.
Design the transition strategy and migration roadmap from current solutions to the future platform.
Identify opportunities for simplification, harmonization, and standardization of data structures and services.
Support the definition of the future service offering, governance model, and cost model for the Data Hub.
Produce business, functional, and data architecture documentation.
Facilitate workshops with stakeholders and knowledge transfer activities.




Required profile (minimum requirements)

Business analysis:

Minimum 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst on enterprise data or information management projects.
Solid experience in business process analysis and requirements engineering.
Experience facilitating workshops with business and technical stakeholders.

Data architecture and modeling:

Minimum 7 years of experience in enterprise data architecture, data modeling, and data warehouse design.
Strong knowledge of Kimball (dimensional modeling) and Inmon (Corporate Information Factory) methodologies.
Experience in conceptual, logical, and physical modeling; data mapping and lineage; master data management (MDM) and metadata.

Modern data platforms:

Experience designing Lakehouse architectures, ideally with Microsoft Fabric and Delta Lake (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers).
Experience with ELT/ETL patterns and migration from traditional data warehouses to cloud platforms.

Transformation and governance:

Experience in legacy platform analysis, migration roadmaps, gap analysis, and platform consolidation.
Experience defining future operating models, service catalogs, and business cases.

Certifications (desirable, not mandatory):

CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or equivalent.
TOGAF Foundation or Certified.
DAMA CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst (Customer & Marketing Analytics)

📍 Lugano | Hybrid Working Model | Permanent Position

About the Company

Our client is a well-established financial services institution operating in Switzerland and committed to leveraging data-driven insights to enhance customer experience, digital engagement and business performance.

To support the continued development of its analytics capabilities, we are looking for a Data Analyst (Customer & Marketing Analytics) to join a dynamic and collaborative team based in Lugano.

This role offers a unique opportunity to combine data analytics, business intelligence, customer insights and predictive modelling within a modern and innovative environment.

Your Mission

As a Data Analyst, you will help transform customer and business data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

Working closely with Marketing, Digital and Business teams, you will contribute to customer segmentation, behavioural analysis, campaign performance measurement and predictive modelling initiatives aimed at optimizing customer engagement and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Analyse customer behaviour, product usage and customer journeys across multiple channels and touchpoints.
Develop customer segmentation and profiling models using demographic, transactional and behavioural data.
Build and maintain predictive models to support business and marketing initiatives.
Extract, manipulate and analyse data from multiple sources using SQL and Python.
Design and automate recurring reporting processes and analytical workflows.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence dashboards and performance reports.
Monitor customer portfolio KPIs and identify actionable business insights.
Collaborate with Marketing and Digital teams to support customer acquisition, retention and engagement strategies.
Ensure data quality, consistency and integrity across reporting and analytical processes.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.

Your Profile

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a related discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics or a similar analytical role.
Strong experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Advanced SQL knowledge.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Practical experience with:
Pandas
NumPy
Scikit-Learn
Experience in statistical analysis, forecasting, customer segmentation or predictive modelling.
Advanced Excel skills.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-driven, proactive and business-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have

Experience within banking, financial services, fintech, payments or credit card environments.
Knowledge of Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI.
Experience with BigQuery, SPSS or similar analytical platforms.
Exposure to machine learning techniques and customer behavioural modelling.
Experience supporting marketing, CRM or customer engagement initiatives.

Languages

Mandatory

Italian – Fluent
English – Fluent
German – Professional proficiency

What’s on Offer

Permanent position within a stable and growing financial services organization.
Hybrid working model.
Exposure to customer analytics, predictive modelling and business intelligence projects.
Collaborative and international working environment.
Modern data and analytics ecosystem.
Long-term career growth opportunities.

If you are passionate about analytics, customer insights and transforming data into business value, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst – Cloud Migration & BigQuery
Description:
Descrizione Del Lavoro

Our organization is launching a strategic initiative to migrate its data infrastructure from an on-premise Oracle Database environment to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The project involves consolidating legacy data warehouses, re-architecting ETL/ELT pipelines, and adopting cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Dataflow.

The selected Data Analyst will be a key contributor across every phase of the migration lifecycle: from as-is data analysis of source systems, through post-migration validation, to supporting business teams in their transition to new cloud-based analytics tools

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Mapping


Inventory and document Oracle source data (schemas, tables, stored procedures, views)
Perform data profiling to identify anomalies, duplicates, and inconsistencies
Define logical data mappings from Oracle to BigQuery for each data domain
Collaborate with data engineers on the definition of transformation rules


Validation & Quality Assurance


Design and implement data reconciliation tests for pre- and post-migration phases
Develop SQL / BigQuery SQL queries to compare source and target datasets
Produce data quality reports covering completeness, accuracy, and consistency metrics
Log and track data anomalies using issue-tracking tools
Strong data modeling skills, including conceptual, logical, and physical design, with hands-on experience in normalization and dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema).﻿


Migration Support ﻿


Actively participate in sprint planning and stand-ups with technical and business teams
Support the migration of legacy reports into GCP-native tools (Looker, Looker Studio)
Contribute to the definition of data governance standards and cloud best practices
Document data transformation processes for knowledge transfer purposes


Personal Profile & Soft Skills﻿


Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Ability to communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders
Operational autonomy and a proactive approach to problem-solving
Good time management in multi-task and project-driven environments
Team player: comfortable working in cross-functional IT/Business teams
Flexibility and adaptability in contexts of technological change
Language: Italian Native or Bilingual
Language: English (written and spoken, minimum B2 level)


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Specialization courses in data engineering, cloud computing, or analytics are a plus

Title: Energy Data Engineer
Description:
Drive the energy transition by providing sustainable technological solutions through our digital platform, facilitating from planning to contract tendering to implementation of renewable energy systems in real estate and industrial companies. We enable our customers to increase the economic efficiency and CO2 balance of their properties while minimizing technical, commercial, and energy risks.

To strengthen our Product Management team, we are looking for an Energy Data Engineer who will contribute to the analysis of energy data, support the development of AI-based price and energy forecasts, and generate actionable insights through the analysis of operational and financial performance. Join this energy revolution and help us transform energy supply in a sustainable and economically viable way!

Tasks


Analyze energy data, including production, consumption, and storage information to identify optimization opportunities
Conduct AI-based market analysis and contribute to the development of price and energy forecasts
Analyze asset data, project progress and operational, environmental as well as financial performance
Perform trend, variance and gap analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations
Validate data quality and perform plausibility checks to continuously improve analytical outputs
Develop and maintain a central data and reporting infrastructure in close collaboration with IT teams
Create KPI reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for internal and external stakeholders
Collaborate closely with management, operations, sales, and country organizations to support data-driven decision-making


Requirements


Completed degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, Physics, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, ideally within an energy sector
Proven experience in designing and building purpose-driven analytical environments
Experienced in building data pipelines, including data extraction, validation, transformation and loading
Practical experience working with modern cloud data infrastructures such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks
Ideally, experience applying and training AI models and machine learning algorithms
High level of proficiency in SQL and solid experience with Python, R, MATLAB or comparable programming languages


Benefits


An attractive salary package and exciting development opportunities
Further training in renewable energies and project management
A dynamic, innovative environment with short decision-making processes and plenty of creative freedom
The opportunity to play an active role in the energy transition and make a real impact

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join us as our new Data Analyst / Business Intelligence

Mission Summary

The Data Analyst supports Gold Avenue's Head of Business Intelligence in keeping the company's data and reporting accurate, consistent and accessible. The role covers data quality checks, tracking maintenance, pipeline monitoring, and maintains the KPIs, dashboards and analytical models that power weekly, monthly and executive reporting. It also serves as a first point of contact for cross-team data requests, helping other departments get, understand and act on the data they need.

Your mission

Data quality & tracking support


Data quality checks: Run routine checks to catch and flag discrepancies between tools, escalating issues that need deeper fixes.
Tracking maintenance: Help maintain tracking standards and naming conventions across Mixpanel, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, keeping the tracking white book up to date.
Pipeline support: Help run and monitor the existing data transformation pipelines (SQL), with senior support on more complex changes.
BI evolution: Contribute to the ongoing Looker Studio to Tableau migration, rebuilding data connections and dashboards alongside the Head of BI.
Roadmap Contribution: Contribute quarterly to BI/data roadmap prioritisation and process/tooling improvements.
Integration Management: Support third-party data integrations, tracking and pipeline adjustments during IT system changes.


Performance Reporting & Analysis


KPI Reporting: Prepare and update the KPIs for the Weekly Business Meeting.
Dashboard maintenance: Keep existing dashboards current and accurate, and help build new views as needs arise.
(CRO) Funnel and conversion analysis. Support CVR and funnel tracking by market and segment, monitor drop-off rates, and report on A/B test results and conversion uplift
Analytical modelling support: Support and maintain the analytical models (LTV, retention cohorts, ROAS) under the guidance of the Head of BI.
Forecasting & Trend Analysis: Support Head of BI in forecast and trend analysis for planning and target-setting


Data Service Center & Cross-team Support


Data Request handling: Act as a first point of contact for cross-department data requests, resolving straightforward tickets and escalating complex ones.
Ad-hoc analysis. Assist teams with queries, attribution questions and deep-dive analyses.
Self-service enablement: Help & empower teams to read and interpret dashboards on their own through documentation and informal training, reducing ad-hoc requests over time.
Stakeholder partnership: Build strong working relationships with Marketing, CRM and Product to anticipate data needs.


Your Skills

Languages & Experience


Native-level French and English.
Bachelor degree in IT/Business/Finance or equivalent
1 to 3 years in a data or analytics role, or a strong graduate with relevant internships and project work.


Technical


Solid SQL and a working understanding of how databases and data warehouses are structured.
Some Python for data transformation and automation, or a clear willingness to grow it.
Exposure to BI tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) and an appetite to develop dashboard skills.
Basic understanding of key ecommerce performance metrics and web tracking tools.
Comfortable in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite.


Behavioral


Attention to detail, with care for data quality, consistency and clean documentation.
Curiosity about ecommerce, growth and conversion metrics, and how data drives business impact.
Clear communicator who can explain findings simply to non-technical audiences.
Proactive and willing to learn, comfortable working with guidance rather than fully alone.
Collaborative across Marketing, Product and CRM teams.


Tools


SQL, Python, Excel / Google Suite, Mixpanel, Tableau / Looker Studio, Google Analytics (GA4), Kochava, Google Tag Manager, Claude AI, Slack

Zimmerwald | 80-100% (Jobsharing möglich)

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten


Strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten aus öffentlich zugänglichen Quellen beschaffen, zusammenführen und analysieren, um nachrichtendienstliche Produkte zu erarbeiten
Geodaten für die nachrichtendienstlichen Produkte aufbereiten; mithilfe von Analysetools und Data-Mining-Methoden Datenanalysen und Modellierungen durchführen; Visualisierungen und Karten erstellen
Informationen bearbeiten und abgleichen, um die aufgestellten Hypothesen zu bestätigen/ zu widerlegen
Die technischen und methodischen Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Web Intelligence / Social Media Intelligence sowie FIMI verfolgen und auswerten
Als kompetente/-r Ansprechpartner/-in für Anfragen, Referate sowie Fachgespräche im eigenen Analysebereich zur Verfügung stehen
Die relevanten Entwicklungen im Bereich der Sicherheitspolitik verfolgen und die eigenen Kenntnisse erweitern


Das macht dich einzigartig


Höhere Fachausbildung: Masterabschluss (Universität/ETH, HF) in Informationstechnologie, Informatik, Politikwissenschaften, Kriminalistik, internationale Beziehungen oder Sicherheitspolitik
Selbständige Arbeitsweise, rasche Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Denken, ausgezeichnete Teamfähigkeit sowie redaktionelle Fähigkeiten
Kenntnisse in OSINT; Beherrschen der Techniken in Internet- und Social-Media-Recherche; Fähigkeit, in digitalen Infrastrukturen Nachforschungen anzustellen
Erfahrung in den Bereichen Programmiersprachen (insbesondere Python) sowie Beschaffungs-, Analyse- und Visualisierungstools; Kenntnisse der Best Practices in Entwicklung (git, CI/CD)
Ziel- und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten; Interesse an neuen Technologien und Themen der internationalen Sicherheitspolitik
Gute aktive Kenntnisse einer zweiten Amtssprache und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil


Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du arbeitest autonom in einem Team von OSINT-Spezialistinnen und -Spezialisten. In diesem dynamischen, auf die Organisationen des Sicherheitsverbundes Schweiz ausgerichteten Arbeitsumfeld trägst du mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein zur Beschaffung nützlicher Informationen für die Sicherheitspolitik der Schweiz bei.

Das bieten wir


Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.
Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.


Alle Benefits

Dein Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit

Das Kommando Cyber (Kdo Cy) steht für Kompetenz in den Bereichen Cyber und Digitalisierung. Wir vereinen die Begeisterung für unsere Aufgabe mit Know-how, Innovation, modernsten Technologien und agilen Arbeitsweisen. Wir erbringen sichere, robuste und resiliente Informatikleistungen für die Schweizer Armee und unsere Partner im Sicherheitsverbund Schweiz. Damit ermöglicht das Kdo Cy der Schweizer Armee den notwendigen Wissens- und Entscheidvorsprung – für eine sichere Schweiz. Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

Title: Analyste en informatique – Data Analyst à la Centrale d’Achats – 100%
Description:
Description De L'entreprise

Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour découvrir les moments forts et chiffres clefs de l'année 2025 en cliquant ici.

Agissant pour le compte des Hôpitaux Universitaires des cantons de Vaud et de Genève, le rôle de la centrale d’achats (CAIB) est de structurer et piloter l’ensemble du processus achats, de la stratégie fournisseurs à la contractualisation et au suivi de la performance.

Description Du Poste

Au sein de la centrale d’achats et rattaché au contrôle de gestion, vous participez au développement, à l'évolution et au pilotage des solutions décisionnelles permettant d'améliorer la performance des achats, la qualité des données et la prise de décision.

Vous intervenez à l'interface entre les équipes métiers, les systèmes d'information et les partenaires institutionnels afin de transformer les données en outils d'aide à la décision.

Ce rôle contribue directement à la transformation de la centrale d’achats, à la gouvernance des données et au pilotage des stratégies achats par catégorie d’articles.

À ce titre, vous analysez les besoins fonctionnels des équipes métiers et proposez des solutions informatiques adaptées. Vous concevez, développez, documentez et faites évoluer les applications décisionnelles, notamment sous QlickSense. Vous développez des tableaux de bord, indicateurs de pilotage, rapports et analyses permettant d'améliorer la performance de la CAIB.

Egalement, vous assurez l'exploitation, la structuration, et la fiabilisation des données achats, fournisseurs, contrats, prix et articles. Vous contribuez à la définition des feuilles de route des outils décisionnels et participez au pilotage de leurs évolutions.

Vous accompagnez les utilisateurs et utilisatrices dans l'utilisation des solutions développées et assurez leur support fonctionnel et participez à la rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles et de la documentation technique.

Vous évaluez les évolutions technologiques, proposez des améliorations des outils décisionnels et contribuez à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion des données et des processus achats.

Dans le cadre du développement de la stratégie Data de la centrale d’achats, vous participez également à l'intégration de solutions d'intelligence artificielle générative et analytique permettant notamment :

la classification automatisée des articles ;

la consolidation des référentiels fournisseurs ;

la détection d'anomalies ;

l'automatisation de certaines analyses ;

l'amélioration de la qualité des données ;

l'aide à la décision des acheteurs.

Force de proposition, vous contribuez activement au développement d'une culture décisionnelle basée sur des données fiables, sécurisées et exploitables.

Qualifications

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en informatique ou en achats, ou d'un diplôme jugé équivalent.

Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée dans le développement de solutions décisionnelles, l'analyse de données ou l'informatique décisionnelle.

Vous maîtrisez les outils de Business Intelligence tels que QlickSense, Power BI ou Business Objects, ainsi que les bases de données relationnelles (SQL).

Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des technologies liées à l'intelligence artificielle générative et analytique ainsi que de leurs applications dans le domaine décisionnel.

Une expérience des ERP (Cegid, SAP, Oracle ou équivalent) et des systèmes d’informations achats (Ivalua, PIM Nextpage ou équivalent) constitue un atout.

Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et de modélisation de données complexes.

Vous êtes reconnu ou reconnue pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie, votre sens du service, votre esprit d'équipe ainsi que votre capacité à vulgariser des informations techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs métiers.

La maîtrise du français est indispensable. Un bon niveau d'anglais constitue un atout.

Informations supplémentaires


Entrée en fonction : à convenir
Nombre de postes : 1
Taux d'activité : 100%
Classe de fonction : 20
Contrat : CDI
Délai de candidature : 10.08.2026
Demande de renseignements : Mme E. Thoor, contrôleuse de gestion, elphie.thoor@hug.ch


Votre dossier de candidature doit comporter une lettre démontrant votre motivation, votre curriculum vitae, les copies des diplômes et attestations requis pour le poste et les 2 derniers certificats de travail.

Cette annonce s'adresse indistinctement aux femmes et aux hommes.

Souhaitant s’engager dans la lutte contre le chômage, les HUG encouragent les candidatures qui proviennent de l’Office cantonal de l’emploi.

Seules les candidatures soumises via la plateforme de recrutement sont prises en compte. Les candidatures papier et mail ne seront pas traitées.

Dans le cadre du développement de la stratégie Data de la centrale d’achats, vous participez également à l'intégration de solutions d'intelligence artificielle générative et analytique permettant notamment :

la classification automatisée des articles ;

la consolidation des référentiels fournisseurs ;

la détection d'anomalies ;

l'automatisation de certaines analyses ;

l'amélioration de la qualité des données ;

l'aide à la décision des acheteurs.

Force de proposition, vous contribuez activement au développement d'une culture décisionnelle basée sur des données fiables, sécurisées et exploitables.

Qualifications

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en informatique ou en achats, ou d'un diplôme jugé équivalent.

Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée dans le développement de solutions décisionnelles, l'analyse de données ou l'informatique décisionnelle.

Vous maîtrisez les outils de Business Intelligence tels que QlickSense, Power BI ou Business Objects, ainsi que les bases de données relationnelles (SQL).

Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des technologies liées à l'intelligence artificielle générative et analytique ainsi que de leurs applications dans le domaine décisionnel.

Une expérience des ERP (Cegid, SAP, Oracle ou équivalent) et des systèmes d’informations achats (Ivalua, PIM Nextpage ou équivalent) constitue un atout.

Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et de modélisation de données complexes.

Vous êtes reconnu ou reconnue pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie, votre sens du service, votre esprit d'équipe ainsi que votre capacité à vulgariser des informations techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs métiers.

La maîtrise du français est indispensable. Un bon niveau d'anglais constitue un atout.

Title: Data & Analytics Specialist (Life Sciences)
Description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company that offers customers from various industries a unique range of analytical services to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat to the water you drink to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the world's largest companies to ensure the products delivered are safe, theirs Ingredients are authentic and labeling is accurate. The company is a leading global provider of analytics for food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetic products as well as contract research (CRO) services.



Eurofins has more than 950+ laboratories within its global network, employing over 65’000 staff.



Eurofins Professional Scientific Service® (PSS) is a global insourcing solution for our customers. Together with the customer, we define a project for the required services that our Eurofins employees should provide at the customer's location. During the ongoing project, the responsibility for project management, the previously defined laboratory services and the deployment of our employees in this project lies with Eurofins PSS.





Job Description



As a Data & Analytics Specialist, you will join the Eurofins Professional Scientific Services (PSS) team to support our client with the development and implementation of data-driven solutions across their Process Science & Tech Ops Department. You will contribute to data analytics, data management, automation, and visualization initiatives, transforming complex data into actionable insights and supporting data quality, governance, and operational efficiency.



This role offers the opportunity to combine analytics, technology, and Life Sciences expertise within a collaborative and international environment.



Contribute to the development and execution of a centralized data strategy, including the rollout of data solutions, data governance and data quality guidelines
Design, develop and implement data analytical solutions for data processing, analysis, and visualization
Develop scalable data pipelines and workflows using Databricks and cloud technologies (AWS)
Maintain and continuously improve databases, supporting systems, templates and metadata to ensure reliable data operations
Monitor data quality metrics and continuously improve data accuracy, consistency, and robustness across systems
Develop automation solutions, web applications and API integrations
Contribute to local and global projects and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders


Qualifications


Degree in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, R, or similar scripting languages
Experience in data analysis, data management, and database systems
Knowledge of Databricks is an advantage
Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS
Experience with web application development and API integrations
Hands-on experience with Power BI and data visualization best practices
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data quality and accuracy
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international project teams


Additional Information



Company Culture



At Eurofins PSS, our company culture is deeply rooted in our four core values: Teamwork, Integrity, Superlative Customer Satisfaction, and Productivity. We believe in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member is encouraged to contribute their unique expertise and ideas. Our commitment to integrity drives us to uphold the highest ethical standards in all our endeavors. We strive for superlative customer satisfaction by understanding and exceeding our clients' expectations. Embracing productivity, we continuously seek innovative ways to streamline processes and deliver exceptional results. Together, these values form the foundation of a supportive and empowering workplace, enabling us to achieve excellence in everything we do.



Opportunities for Growth



As part of our commitment to employee development, we offer abundant growth opportunities at Eurofins PSS. You'll have access to learning and development programs, coaching & mentorship, and the chance to take on challenging projects, empowering you to achieve your professional aspirations.



Equal Opportunity Employer Statement



At Eurofins PSS, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, embracing diversity, and cultivating an inclusive workplace where every individual's unique background and perspective are valued, respected, and celebrated.







Please note that as per Eurofins policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters were engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that Eurofins will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

Zimmerwald | 80-100% (jobsharing possible)
