Collecter, fusionner et analyser des données structurées et non structurées issues de sources ouvertes, afin d'élaborer des produits de renseignement
Préparer des géodonnées pour les produits de renseignement, réaliser des analyses de données et des modélisations (à l'aide d'outils d'analyse et des méthodes de data mining), créer des visualisations et autres cartographies
Traiter et croiser les informations pour confirmer/ infirmer les hypothèses faites
Suivre et évaluer les évolutions techniques et méthodiques dans le domaine Web intelligence/ Social Media intelligence ainsi que dans la thématique FIMI
Assumer le rôle d'interlocuteur/-trice qualifié/-e pour des demandes, des exposés et des entretiens techniques dans votre domaine d'analyse
Suivre les développements pertinents en matière de politique de sécurité et élargir ses connaissances


Ce qui te rend unique


Formation spécialisée supérieure : master (université/ EPF, ES) en technologie de l'information, informatique, sciences politiques ou criminelles, relations internationales, politique de sécurité
Autonomie, vivacité d'esprit, pensée analytique, excellent esprit d'équipe et aisance rédactionnelle
Connaissances en OSINT, maîtrise des techniques de recherche sur internet et les réseaux sociaux, capacité à investiguer des infrastructures numériques
Expérience dans les domaines suivants : langages de programmation (Python en particulier) ; outils utilisés en matière de collecte, d'analyse et de visualisation ; connaissances des bonnes pratiques de développement (git, CI/CD)
Capacité à se focaliser sur les objectifs et les résultats, intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et les sujets liés à la politique de sécurité internationale
Bonnes connaissances actives dans une deuxième langue officielle, ainsi que de très bonnes connaissances en anglais. La maîtrise d'autres langues étrangères constitue un avantage


En quelques mots

Tu travailleras de manière autonome au sein d'une équipe de spécialistes OSINT. Dans cet environnement de travail dynamique, axé sur les organisations du Réseau national de sécurité, tu faites preuve d'un niveau élevé de responsabilités et veux contribuer à l'acquisition d'informations utiles à la politique de sécurité de la Suisse.

Title: Analyste de données
Description:
Poste: Bienne




Contrat: Contrat à durée indéterminée avec Alten Suisse.




Nous recherchons un(e) Analyste de données pour rejoindre un environnement industriel à forte exigence qualité et contribuer à la fiabilisation, à l’analyse et à l’optimisation des données de référence. Véritable interface entre les opérations et les systèmes d’information, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la cohérence des données, l’amélioration continue des processus et le succès des projets de transformation.




Responsabilités :




Assurer la création, la mise à jour et le nettoyage des données de référence en garantissant leur cohérence et leur intégrité
Veiller à l’alignement entre les données présentes dans les systèmes d’information et la réalité du terrain
Analyser la qualité des données, identifier les écarts et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires
Participer activement aux initiatives d’amélioration continue visant à renforcer la fiabilité et la stabilité des données
Contribuer à la définition et à la maintenance des standards liés aux temps opératoires et aux données industrielles associées
Réaliser les analyses et chiffrages nécessaires à la gestion des temps de production et assurer la saisie des informations de référence
Accompagner les projets de migration et de transformation des systèmes en garantissant la conformité et la qualité des données
Apporter un support aux équipes métiers en traitant les anomalies, investigations et demandes opérationnelles
Collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un contexte transverse et multidisciplinaire




Qualifications :




Formation technique supérieure (ES, CFC complété par une spécialisation, ou équivalent)
Expérience significative dans l’analyse, la gestion ou la gouvernance des données au sein d’un environnement industriel
Excellente compréhension des données techniques et industrielles telles que les nomenclatures, gammes, coûts de fabrication ou données d’assemblage
Bonne maîtrise des systèmes ERP, idéalement SAP, ainsi que des solutions PLM
Une connaissance d’outils de reporting ou de pilotage de données constitue un atout
Solides capacités d’analyse et aptitude à structurer des informations complexes
Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et approche méthodique
Français courant




Postulez dès maintenant et faites partie de notre incroyable aventure. Nous croyons en une croissance commune !

Title: Business/Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Ekkiden ist eine in 2019 gegründete internationale Beratungsgruppe: sie vereint ein Ökosystem leidenschaftlicher und engagierter Beraterinnen und Berater, die Transformationsprojekte in den Bereichen Organisation, Operations und Technologie durchführen, insbesondere in IT/Digital, Industrie/F&E sowie Nachhaltigkeit, für Großunternehmen und KMU in Frankreich, der Schweiz, Spanien und Deutschland.

Über die Rolle

Als Business Analyst und/oder Data Analyst übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, Data/BI und IT. Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, definierst Kennzahlen und Berichte und trägst so massgeblich zu datenbasierten Entscheidungen und zur Optimierung der Geschäftsabläufe bei.

Aufgaben


Aufnahme, Analyse und Strukturierung von fachlichen und datenbezogenen Anforderungen aus den Business Units
Analyse und Dokumentation von Geschäftsprozessen sowie der zugrunde liegenden Datenflüsse und Systeme.
Durchführung von Datenanalysen und Auswertungen (z. B. in Excel oder BI-Tools) zur Unterstützung von Management-Entscheidungen.
Definition von KPIs, Reports und Dashboards in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Data/BI-Teams.
Erstellung von Fachkonzepten, Spezifikationen und User Stories für datengetriebene Lösungen (Reporting, Analytics, Automatisierung).
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit IT, Data Engineers und BI-Spezialisten bei der Umsetzung der Anforderungen in Datenmodelle und Berichte.
Kontinuierliche Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen in Prozessen, Datenqualität und Transparenz.
Strukturierte Dokumentation von fachlichen Anforderungen, Prozessen und relevanten Datenstrukturen.


Must-have


Mehrjährige Erfahrung (5+) als Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im datengetriebenen Umfeld
Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis.
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Daten und Reporting (z. B. Excel, SQL-Grundlagen oder gängige BI-Tools z.B. Power BI)
Erfahrung in der Aufnahme und Dokumentation von Anforderungen (z. B. mittels Use Cases, User Stories, Fachkonzepten).
Sicheres Auftreten und starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit gegenüber fachlichen und technischen Stakeholdern.
Strukturierte, selbständige Arbeitsweise und hohe Qualitätsorientierung.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) in Wort und Schrift, gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil.


Nice to have


Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung, DWH- oder ETL-Konzepten.
Erfahrung in agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) und Arbeit mit Tools wie Jira und Confluence.
Kenntnisse in Prozessmodellierung (z. B. BPMN, UML).


Wie sieht der Rekrutierungsprozess bei Ekkiden aus?

Bei Ekkiden sind wir bestrebt, jedem Kandidaten eine positive Erfahrung zu bieten.


Erstgespräch: Unser Rekrutierungsteam wird sich mit Ihnen in Verbindung setzen, um Ihre Motivation und Erwartungen zu besprechen.
Interviews: Je nach der Rolle, für die Sie sich bewerben, führen Sie ein oder zwei Interviews mit unseren Geschäftsleitern.
Kundengespräch: Schließlich haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Kunden kennenzulernen.


Obwohl dies unser Standardprozess ist, können wir Anpassungen vornehmen, die auf spezifischen Umständen basieren.

Title: Data & Reporting Specialist (FAP-BC-DL-2026-203-GRAE)
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data, problem-solving, and turning complex information into clear insights? Do you enjoy maintaining and improving data systems, from legacy databases to modern reporting platforms? Join our agile, self-organised team of engineers to help maintain and develop CERN's Corporate Information Systems! Take Part! You'll be part of the Business Computing (BC) group, supporting Finance and Procurement.

Your mission: analyse, improve, and help modernise reporting and data solutions, while supporting the transformation of CERN's enterprise systems and ensuring that future analytics needs are properly understood and addressed.

Your responsibilities:


Extract, transform, model, and visualise data in reports, dashboards, and analytics platforms;
Interact with relational databases, mainly Oracle, using SQL and PL/SQL;
Develop, maintain, and test reporting data models and semantic models supporting CERN's Finance and Procurement systems;
Maintain, support, and enhance existing reporting and data solutions while helping define and implement their future evolution;
Contribute to data profiling, mapping, quality checks, validation, and reconciliation activities during migration and transition phases;
Contribute to the development and maintenance of ETL/ELT pipelines and other data-processing activities where required;
Collaborate with business users, functional experts, architects, and developers to ensure data consistency, usability, and technical feasibility;
Support testing, troubleshooting, documentation, maintenance, and third-level support for reporting and data solutions.


Your profile:

Data Analysis & Reporting:


Experience in SQL (writing, optimising, debugging complex queries).
Familiarity with data visualisation or analytics tools such as Power BI, R, or Python-based dashboards.
Understanding of data modelling principles (dimensional/star schema design, semantic models, data warehouses).
Experience analysing data structures, flows, and dependencies in complex enterprise systems.


Data Engineering:


Exposure to data pipeline concepts and tools such as SQL, dbt, Airflow, or Python for data processing.
Interest in maintaining and modernising reporting and data solutions during a systems transformation.


Business Processes & User Support:


Interest in providing end-user support, troubleshooting, escalation, and issue resolution.
Awareness of Finance and Procurement processes or interest in learning about business domains.


Collaboration:


Experience working in group projects, ideally in collaborative or Agile environments.


Skills:

Data & Analytics:


Excellent knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Knowledge of data visualisation and analytics tools, particularly Power BI.
Ability to contribute to the design and maintenance of data models for reporting and analytics.
Ability to understand and document complex data structures, data flows, dependencies, and transformation logic.


Data Governance & Quality:


Awareness of data quality, security, and governance concepts.
Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.


Technical Environment:


Knowledge of version control systems and basic interaction with Linux servers via the command line.
Knowledge of Agile practices and experience maintaining reporting solutions and data pipelines in an agile environment.
Comfortable in working with both new and legacy systems.


Communication & Collaboration:


Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex information effectively.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:


You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.


Additional Information

Job closing date: 30.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-November-2026

This position involves:


Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: FAP-BC-DL-2026-203-GRAE

Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics

Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits


A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.
30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
On-the-job and formal training including language classes.


Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

More information about us, here: careers.cern

Title: Data Scientist, Marketing Analytics
Description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:


SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.


Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:


Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.


With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position Description

This role is the data team's dedicated analytical partner for Marketing. Your core job is to turn marketing data into decisions: diagnose what is working and what is not, explain why, and recommend where to spend the next dollar. You will own marketing attribution, ROI, and conversion analysis end to end, and you will be proactive about it, surfacing findings and opportunities before anyone asks.

You will explore data, form hypotheses, and partner with our Data and Analytics Engineers to shape the models and pipelines you need. You will help define those models, but your primary measure of success is the quality and impact of your analysis.

This role sits in the Data & Insights team and partners closely with Marketing, IT/Marketing Ops, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and data scientists covering other domains.

What You Will Do


Drive marketing decisions with analysis. Own attribution, ROI, conversion, and funnel analysis. Diagnose drops and anomalies, quantify what drives them, and translate findings into clear recommendations for marketing leaders.
Optimize marketing spend. Connect spend to outcomes across channels and campaigns, and advise on where to invest, cut, or test next.
Be proactive. Explore and correlate data to surface insights nobody asked for. Anticipate the next question. Bring opportunities to the marketing team rather than waiting for requests.
Run experiments. Design and read out A/B tests and other experiments, applying sound statistical methods and being honest about significance and causality.
Partner on the data foundation. Work hand in hand with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to get marketing data into the warehouse and modeled. Define requirements, explore raw data, and contribute to data models that connect marketing data with sales and product data.
Tell the story. Communicate insights so non-technical stakeholders can act, and document context, caveats, and decisions so the work survives handoffs.


Experience And Qualifications


Strong analytical track record: someone who has measurably influenced business or marketing decisions through analysis, not just produced reports.
Comfort with the latest AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and sharper: exploring data, writing and debugging code, drafting analysis, and accelerating insight. You stay current as the tooling evolves and bring new approaches to the team.
Eagerness to develop: you actively grow your skills, seek feedback, and treat new tools and methods as opportunities rather than threats.
Solid SQL. You can independently query, join, and explore data without waiting for someone to prepare it for you.
Proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation.
Statistical foundation: experimentation, significance testing, regression, segmentation, forecasting, and the judgment to know which applies.
Working knowledge of marketing and GTM data: channels, campaigns, attribution models, funnel and conversion metrics, and the realities of joining marketing data to CRM/sales and product usage data.
Willingness to get hands-on with data modeling. You don't need to be a dbt expert, but you must be comfortable exploring messy data and partnering on (or building) the models you need rather than waiting for clean tables.
Strong communication and stakeholder skills: you can challenge weak measurement respectfully and make a recommendation, not just present options.
Proactivity and autonomy: you raise your hand early, plan your own work, and look for impact without being asked.


In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at [email protected] .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Contract: 1-year fixed term (extension possible)
Rate: 100%
Start date: 1 September 2026 (or by agreement)


📥 Interested? Apply now!

What You'll Do


Gather, clean and structure data from a range of internal and external sources
Build reports, dashboards and visualisations that inform business decisions
Help safeguard data quality and consistency across systems
Work with DevOps tooling (Git, Jira, CI/CD pipelines)
Support the publication and management of Open Data datasets

Document data processes and methodologies

Help run and facilitate stakeholder workshops

Ideally, exposure to Open Data or research-data environments (visualisation, pipelines)
A talent for making data and technology accessible to any audience

Description:

Die AMAG Import AG ist mit den Marken Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, CUPRA, Škoda und VW Nutzfahrzeuge der erfolgreichste Automobil-Importeur der Schweiz.

Innerhalb des Data-Teams im Group Aftersales am Hauptsitz in Cham ZG suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine analytisch starke, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit als Data Specialist (m/w/d) 80-100%.

In dieser Rolle verbindest du anspruchsvolles operatives Stammdatenmanagement mit Datenqualität, Prozessverbesserung und Digitalisierung. Du arbeitest nahe am Tagesgeschäft, bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv ein und unterstützt uns dabei, unser Datenmanagement schrittweise weiterzuentwickeln.

Wie wir dich begeistern


Spezialkonditionen bei Fahrzeugkauf und Service: Für dich und deine Familie – weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Mobilität ist
Reisen mit Vergünstigungen: Weltweit günstiger unterwegs mit Europcar
ZIF: Zusätzliche individuelle Freitage – Kaufe dir zusätzliche Urlaubstage und gönne dir eine wohlverdiente längere Auszeit
Flexibilität leben: Vereinbare Familie, Hobby und Beruf – geniesse die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens
Life long learning: Wir beteiligen uns an deiner Weiterbildung – booste deine Karriere!
Fit for free: Nutze unser kostenloses Fitnessstudio für deine Gesundheit und Fitness
Exklusive Deals:Plattform mit wechselnden Vergünstigungen – entdecke immer wieder neue Angebote und spare dabei


Was du bei uns bewegen kannst


Stammdaten und Datenqualität: Du erfasst, pflegst und überwachst Material- und Produktstammdaten und stellst deren Qualität, Vollständigkeit und Verfügbarkeit über den gesamten Lebenszyklus sicher
Datenprobleme nachhaltig lösen: Du analysierst Fehler und Qualitätsprobleme in Datenflüssen, Systemen und Schnittstellen, identifizierst deren Ursachen und setzt gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern nachhaltige Verbesserungsmassnahmen um
Stammdatenprozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst und dokumentierst bestehende Daten- und Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst diese in deinem Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich weiter
Digitalisierung und Automatisierung: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und realisierst gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT pragmatische digitale und automatisierte Lösungen
Fachbereich vertreten: Du übersetzt fachliche Bedürfnisse in nachvollziehbare Anforderungen für Systeme, Schnittstellen und Datenstrukturen und begleitest die Entwicklung, Einführung und fachlichen Tests neuer Lösungen
Projekte und Beratung: Du arbeitest in bereichsübergreifenden Transformationsprojekten mit, übernimmst klar abgegrenzte Teilprojekte und bringst dein Fachwissen bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer ERP-, Prozess- und Stammdatenlandschaft ein
Regulatorische Produktdaten: Du arbeitest dich in sicherheits-, chemikalien- und gefahrstoffrelevante Produktdaten ein und unterstützt deren korrekte Abbildung in unseren Datenprozessen


Das bringst du mit


Aus- und Weiterbildung: Du verfügst über einen Abschluss auf Stufe HF oder FH in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Data Management, Prozessmanagement oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Stammdaten-, Produktdaten-, Daten- oder Prozessmanagement mit ERP- und Datenkompetenz: Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse von ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP und hast Erfahrung mit Stammdatenstrukturen, Datenanalyse, Datenvalidierung oder Reporting Prozess- und Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Daten, Systeme und Geschäftsprozesse zusammenspielen und kannst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit IT oder anderen Fachstellen in umsetzbare Lösungen überführen. Projekt- und Digitalisierungsaffinität: Du hast bereits in Projekten mitgearbeitet und interessierst dich für Automatisierung, neue Datenmanagementlösungen und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Arbeitsweisen. Arbeitsweise und Sprachkenntnisse: Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich, denkst analytisch und vernetzt und kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch sowie gut auf Englisch.


Denkst du, dass wir zusammenpassen könnten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Übrigens: Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Hast du Fragen zur Stelle oder zum Bewerbungsprozess? Dann kontaktiere mich doch einfach per WhatsApp Kurznachricht. Informationen zum Datenschutz findest du in unseren Datenschutzbestimmungen.

Business Intelligence Developer

Dich begeistern Innovationen, die neusten Systeme, ein agiles Setting und neue Herausforderungen? Dann bist du bei Livit genau richtig. Wir freuen uns auf deinen persönlichen Beitrag.
 

Zürich

100 - 100%

Du unterstützt unser BI-Team von der Konzeption und dem Design bis zur Entwicklung, dem Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung unserer BI- und Reporting-Lösungen
Du spezifizierst, entwickelst und wartest Kunden-Reports in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern
Du stellst die fach- und termingerechte Bereitstellung von elektronischen Schnittstellen und Reports für interne und externe Empfänger sicher
Du dokumentierst, wartest und optimierst bestehende sowie neu entwickelte Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse und Reporting-Lösungen
Du arbeitest im Rahmen der Ablösung unseres Immobilien-ERP-Systems aktiv an der Migration und Neuentwicklung bestehender Data-Warehouse- und Reporting-Lösungen mit
Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen im Bereich Data Warehouse und Reporting
Du trägst mit Deiner Expertise zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Business-Intelligence-Services bei

Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufsbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ oder über eine entsprechende höhere Ausbildung (HF, FH oder Universität) mit Schwerpunkt Informatik
Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Datenbankentwicklung mit MS SQL Server mit und verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in den Technologien SSRS, SSIS sowie in der Entwicklung von Stored Procedures
Du besitzt idealerweise Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL und bringst Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit unterschiedlichen Datenbanksystemen mit
Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Entwicklungstools wie SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), DBeaver, RedGate Toolbelt, Visual Studio sowie Confluence und JIRA
Du hast von Vorteil bereits Erfahrungen in der Immobilienbranche gesammelt, insbesondere in der Bewirtschaftung oder Liegenschaftsbuchhaltung
Du kennst idealerweise die Immobiliensoftware G-REM von GARAIO REM
Du kommunizierst stilsicher in Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Du zeichnest dich durch eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Eigeninitiative ein und arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Anspruchsgruppen

Home- / Mobile Office

Description:
Le cabinet Sigma Suisse, basé à Plan-les-Ouates, est un cabinet de recrutement spécialisé dans le recrutement de profils informatique et stratégiques accompagnant des acteurs influent en Suisse romande.




Au sein du département IT, nous intervenons sur des besoins relatifs aux secteurs du Trading de matières premières ou financiers, Pharmaceutique, Aéronautique, Spatial, Énergie, Horlogerie et des fondations Suisse.




Nous recrutons un(e) BI / Data Engineer pour un groupe agro-industriel international, poste fixe basé à Fribourg, sur site.




Le contexte, un écosystème BI (Data Warehouse, SSRS, Tableau) au coeur du pilotage d'un siège et de filiales multi-pays. Votre rôle, reprendre et développer l'opérationnel BI, faire évoluer le Data Warehouse et accompagner les projets Data transverses.




Ce que vous ferez :




Concevoir, développer et maintenir les rapports et tableaux de bord du catalogue BI Groupe sous SSRS et Tableau
Garantir la fiabilité, la performance et la disponibilité des rapports en production
Prioriser et traiter les demandes évolutives et correctives remontées par les métiers et les filiales
Assurer le support BI aux utilisateurs du siège et des filiales, gérer les accès et le suivi des tickets
Accompagner la montée en autonomie des Business Owners et des utilisateurs clés
Faire évoluer le Data Warehouse, schémas, tables, vues et data marts, au service des besoins métiers
Développer et maintenir les flux d'alimentation ETL / SSIS depuis les applications sources (ERP, RH, agro)
Veiller à la qualité, la cohérence et l'exploitabilité des données
Contribuer aux chantiers Data transverses, référentiel Agro, reporting industriel, SEI, IBM PA, ArcGIS
Travailler en lien avec les équipes dev / applications, infrastructure et cybersécurité




Le profil :




3 ans minimum en BI / Data Engineering
Solide maîtrise SQL et SQL Server
Expérience Data Warehouse et notions ETL (SSIS)
Connaissance ERP
Français langue maternelle, anglais C1




Un plus selon votre appétence, DBA SQL Server, IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), Architecture Data / MDM ou Power BI.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer (M/F)- Geneva
Description:
Main responsibilities:

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will support business units in analysing their reporting and data utilisation needs in order to aid decision-making. You will design, develop and maintain dashboards and Business Intelligence solutions, whilst contributing to the continuous improvement of the company’s data strategy.




You will be part of a dynamic and expert team, where you will be encouraged to put forward innovative ideas, develop new concepts and play an active role in strategic projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.

Gather, analyse and translate business requirements into relevant reporting solutions.

Recommend improvements to optimise Business Intelligence processes and tools.

Help define the product vision and data strategy.

Monitor, control and troubleshoot daily data processing operations.

Support strategic projects in your capacity as a Business Intelligence specialist.

Ensure the quality, consistency and reliability of the data made available to users.

Draft and maintain technical and functional documentation for BI processes.

Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure that solutions meet users’ needs.




Education:

Higher education qualification (university or university of applied sciences) in:

Computer Science, Engineering, Data & Analytics, or an equivalent field.




Experience:

At least 5 years’ experience in Business Intelligence.

Experience in the banking or financial sector would be an advantage.




Proficiency in Microsoft BI technologies:

SQL Server (T-SQL)

SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)

SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)

Power BI




A good understanding of decision-making architectures, data flows and analytical models is required.




Soft skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and a sense of responsibility.

Initiative and a focus on continuous improvement.

Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with both business and technical stakeholders.

Team spirit and a focus on internal customers.




Languages:

Fluent English & Portuguese(essential).

Fluency in French or German is an asset, depending on the company’s context.




Technical environment:

Microsoft Power BI

Microsoft SQL Server

T-SQL

SSIS

SSAS

SSRS

Data Warehouse / Business Intelligence environment

Title: Ingénieur de données/Ingénieure de données
Description:
CLEEVEN est un cabinet de conseil européen fondé autour de deux convictions fondamentales :

L'excellence des ingénieurs européens doit être un moteur de la compétitivité mondiale
Notre mission humaine : accompagner nos consultants dans leur développement personnel et professionnel

Présent en Suisse, nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs projets de transformation digitale et de valorisation de la donnée.




Contexte du projet :

Nous recherchons un Data Analyst / BI Engineer pour accompagner le développement et l'évolution de solutions de reporting et d'analyse décisionnelle.

Vous interviendrez au croisement des enjeux métiers et techniques afin de transformer des données complexes en indicateurs de pilotage et en outils d'aide à la décision. Vous participerez à l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée : compréhension des besoins, modélisation, construction de tableaux de bord et amélioration continue des solutions analytiques.




Objectifs du projet :

Recueillir et analyser les besoins de reporting et d'analyse des équipes métiers.
Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord et solutions de reporting.
Extraire, transformer et analyser des données provenant de multiples sources.
Construire et faire évoluer des modèles de données et des couches sémantiques.
Définir et suivre des KPIs permettant de piloter l'activité.
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données.
Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'exploitation des outils décisionnels.
Participer à l'amélioration continue de l'écosystème BI et Data de l'entreprise.




Compétences clés :

Solides compétences en SQL et en bases de données relationnelles.
Expérience sur des outils de Business Intelligence et de visualisation de données.
Bonne maîtrise des concepts de modélisation de données.
Capacité à traduire des besoins métiers en solutions de reporting concrètes.
Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
Aisance dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques.
Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel.

Nice To Have

Expérience avec Looker et/ou LookML.
Expérience avec Power BI, Tableau ou des outils similaires.
Connaissances des concepts ETL/ELT et des pipelines de données.
Expérience sur des plateformes cloud (GCP, Azure ou AWS).
Expérience dans un environnement industriel ou manufacturier.
Connaissances de Python pour l'analyse de données ou l'automatisation.




Profil recherché :

Formation supérieure en informatique, data, systèmes d'information, mathématiques, statistiques ou ingénierie.
Expérience en tant que Data Analyst, BI Engineer ou sur un poste similaire.
Forte capacité d'analyse et sens du détail.
Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métiers et à transformer les données en informations exploitables.




À très vite !

OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert

Fluent in Italian and English

Title: Data Analyst for Beam Instrumentation (SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP)
Description:
Job Details

Job Description

As an experienced Data Analyst with a solid background in physics, you will join the team responsible for the LHC Longitudinal Density Monitor (commonly known as the BSRL: Beam Synchrotron Radiation Longitudinal monitor) within the Beam Instrumentation Group.

In this role, you will lead the work on the online and offline data processing pipelines, which are fully implemented in Python. The analysis results from this instrument are mission-critical, directly impacting the calibration of the LHC experiments, facilitating the troubleshooting of operational issues, and enabling detailed beam physics analysis.

Additionally, you will play an important role in R&D and optimisation, conducting advanced studies to shape the upcoming upgrades of the BSRL instrument.

Your Responsibilities


Lead the redesign and optimisation of the current online and offline Python data analysis software for the BSRL instrument to ensure scalability, performance and reproducibility.
Develop specialised offline analysis routines using BSRL data, cross-correlating with other beam instrumentation where necessary, to meet the requirements of stakeholders.
Extend the online and offline diagnostics tools, architecting automated notification systems to detect early signs of instrument degradation, anomalies, or malfunctions.
Design and implement the specific software tools, calibration routines, and data pipelines required for the rapid commissioning of the renovated system after the Long Shutdown 3 (LS3).
Contribute to the validation and performance verification of the associated upgraded hardware planned for deployment during LS3.
Evaluate and benchmark different upgrade scenarios for LS3 by combining advanced data analysis of historical run data with physics-based simulation techniques.


Your profile


Proven background in the advanced analysis of complex experimental data, preferably from physics or large-scale scientific installations.
Extensive experience in software development with a strong emphasis on clean, maintainable code.
Basic experience in Monte Carlo-based physics simulation techniques.
Basic experience with laboratory work.


Skills


In-depth knowledge of advanced statistical methods, data modelling, and data analysis techniques applied to scientific datasets.
Proven proficiency in Python, including familiarity with the standard scientific stack (such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, etc) for high-performance processing.
Knowledge of version control systems (Git/Gilab) and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
Basic knowledge of photon counting techniques would be advantage.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility Criteria


You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Data Analytics (or a related field) and have either:
a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Additional Information

Job closing date: 24.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-December-2026

This Position Involves


Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP

Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics

Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits


A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.
30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
On-the-job and formal training including language classes.


Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

More information about us, here: careers.cern

Expérience des architectures Data Warehouse, des modèles de Business Intelligence, du reporting et des outils ETL ou ELT.

Title: Market Risk - Data Engineer
Description:
Main purpose

We are looking for a highly motivated Market Risk - Data Engineer to join Trafigura’s Market Risk team at the intersection of commodity trading and cutting-edge AI. This role goes beyond traditional risk analysis: you will harness agentic AI to build automated workflows, design analytical tools, and deliver rapid, high-quality insights that directly support trading decisions across our Oil & Petroleum Products, Metals, and Power & Gas divisions. If you are passionate about building things — from polished, production-ready processes to fast, creative ad hoc analyses — and you want to do it in one of the world’s most dynamic commodity trading environments, this is the role for you.

Key responsibilities

Build Data & Analytics Solutions

Develop and maintain data pipelines that support daily market risk processes and analytics.

Design and implement tools to automate data ingestion, validation, reporting, and analysis workflows.

Build scalable solutions that improve the quality, accessibility, and timeliness of risk data.

Apply AI & Automation

Help design and deploy AI-enabled workflows that support risk analysis, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, automation frameworks, and agent-based solutions.

Contribute to a shared library of reusable tools and frameworks that can be leveraged across the Market Risk function.

Support Quantitative Risk Analytics

Contribute to the development and enhancement of market risk models and metrics, including:

Value-at-Risk (VaR)

Stress testing and scenario analysis

Sensitivity analysis and Greeks

P&L explain and attribution

Partner with market risk managers and traders to deliver actionable insights and analytical support.

Ensure Operational Excellence

Monitor and maintain production data pipelines and analytics processes.

Investigate and resolve data quality issues, process failures, and exceptions.

Contribute to best practices in software development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.

Support continuous improvements in system reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Required qualifications

Minimum 2–4 years’ experience in market risk, quantitative finance, or a related analytics role within commodity trading or financial services.

Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-quality solutions.

Experience working with data pipelines, APIs, data processing frameworks, or workflow automation tools.

Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, and code quality practices.

Interest in applying AI and automation technologies to solve business problems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in financial markets, commodities, risk management, or trading environments.

Familiarity with market risk concepts such as VaR, stress testing, sensitivities, or P&L analysis.

Exposure to AI/LLM technologies, including APIs, prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or workflow automation tools.

Experience with cloud platforms, data platforms, or modern analytics environments such as Snowflake or Databricks.

Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or related engineering practices.

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

Attributes for success

Intellectually curious and self-driven, with a bias for action — you move quickly from idea to working solution without waiting to be asked.

AI-first mindset: genuinely excited by agentic AI and actively seeks opportunities to deploy it across the team’s workflows — not just as a personal productivity tool but as shared infrastructure that multiplies the team’s output.

Attention to detail: maintains rigorous accuracy when working with complex models, data, and code to minimise risk and errors in a production environment.

Communication: clearly conveys technical concepts and issues to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, enabling fast and effective decision-making.

Resilience and adaptability: remains composed under pressure — whether navigating a production incident, a tight deadline, or a rapidly shifting AI landscape — and adapts quickly without losing rigour.

Department overview

The Market Risk team is a globally integrated function embedded at the heart of Trafigura's commodity trading operations, covering Oil & Petroleum Products, Metals, and Power & Gas. We partner directly with commercial and trading teams to quantify, monitor, and manage risk exposures across the full trade life cycle — from origination through settlement. The team maintains a strong quantitative focus and is actively investing in AI and automation to enhance both the depth and speed of our risk analytics. You would join a collegial, intellectually driven group that values initiative and innovation, with significant visibility into senior leadership and direct impact on the business.

Equal opportunity employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Title: Business Analyst/Consultant - Künstliche Intelligenz & Daten (Data Management & Datenplattformen Fokus)
Description:
Job Description

Location: Zurich

Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%

Möchtest du im Bereich Consulting für Künstliche Intelligenz und Dat en Kundinnen und Kunden dabei unterstützen, strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen? Unser Team begleitet die Umsetzung umfangreicher Datenprogramme. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft.

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Aufbau modernster Datenlandschaften, um ihre Analysefähigkeit auf das nächste Level zu bringen. Du analysierst und verstehst kundenspezifische Lösungen von der Datenintegration, Datentransformation bis hin zu Analytics - mit dem Ziel das Datenmanagement unter Einsatz von State- of - the -Art Technologien nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Für diese Position bieten wir derzeit Starttermine ab September 202 6 an.

Dein Impact


Entwurf und Implementierung moderner Datenlösungen im Bereich Datenmanagement (z. B. Datenqualität, Stamm- und Referenzdaten, Datenkataloge und Datenplattformen), um qualitativ hochwertige und verwertbare Daten bereitzustellen.
Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, die unseren Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Geschäftsziele in den Bereichen Compliance, Kostensenkung und Umsatzsteigerung zu erreichen.
Konzeption komplexer Daten- und Analytik-Transformationen durch die Bereitstellung architektonischer, technischer und organisatorischer Grundlagen sowie Beratung der Kunden bei der Durchführung dieser Transformationen, die erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Organisation haben .
Aufbau und Pflege enger Kundenbeziehungen im Rahmen von Projektarbeit oder Business Development sowie Erweiterung des internen und externen Netzwerks.
Vorbildfunktion durch hohe Arbeitsmoral, ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten und fachliche Kompetenz.
Weiterentwicklung deiner Kompetenzen in verschiedenen Branchen und Fachgebieten sowie Weitergabe deines Wissens an Kolleginnen und Kollegen.



Wen wir suchen

Antrieb und Motivation


Leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeiten, die eine Karriere in der Beratung mit Schwerpunkt Data Engineering aufbauen möchten .
Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, Offenheit für neue Themen und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben selbstständig in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu steuern .



Beratungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten


Starke Schreib- und Microsoft PowerPoint-Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, aussagekräftige Präsentationen zu gestalten .
Starke konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu einem stimmigen Lösungsdesign zusammenzuführen und komplexe Probleme zu vereinfachen .
Business-IT-Übersetzer: Fähigkeit, als Brücke zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und technischen Lösungen zu fungieren .
Liebe zum Detail und Fähigkeit, technische Spezifikationen klar in schriftlicher und mündlicher Form zu kommunizieren .



Technische Expertise


Praktische Erfahrung mit Datenmanagement, Datenplattformen oder Data Engineering-Lösungen ist dringend empfohlen .
Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und Python sind erforderlich .
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Azure oder GCP, einschließlich der Arbeit mit Data Warehouses , ETL-Tools und modernen Data Stack-Technologien ist erforderlich .
Kenntnisse von Datenplattform-Tools (z.B. Snowflake, Databricks , Apache Spark, Airflow ) und Datenvisualisierungstools (z.B. PowerBI , Tableau) sind erforderlich .
Praktische Erfahrung mit ETL/ELT-Pipelines und Data Orchestration (z.B. Apache Airflow , Prefect , dbt ) ist erforderlich .
Verständnis von Data Warehouse- und Data Lake-Architekturen sowie deren Unterschiede und Anwendungsfälle .
Kenntnisse von Datenmodellierung und Optimierungstechniken .
Starker Ingenieur- oder Mathematik-Hintergrund ist vorteilhaft .



Sprachkompetenz


Fließend in Englisch , Deutsch und/oder Französisch ist sehr erwünscht, um die Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zu erleichtern .



Branchenerfahrun g


Erste relevante Erfahrung in Beratung, Technologieunternehmen oder branchenspezifischen Rollen, insbesondere in datengestützten Bereichen .
Frühere Erfahrung im Banking-, Versicherungs-, Life Science- oder Healthcare -Sektor ist vorteilhaft .



Dein Team

Werde Teil eines diversen und multinationalen Teams von 50+ hochmotivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen in unseren Büros in Zürich, Genf oder Basel. Wir sind spezialisiert auf KI und Daten - wie sie strukturiert, beschafft, transformiert, gespeichert und genutzt werden können. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen und unterhaltsamen Teams und arbeite mit hochtalentierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen an abwechslungsreichen und spannenden Projekten, mit Zugang zu hervorragenden und fortlaufend verfügbaren Lernmöglichkeiten.

Deloitte AI & Data ist das führende Data & Analytics Consulting Team in der Schweiz. Du wirst die Möglichkeit haben, mit erstklassigen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu arbeiten und Zugang zu einer Vielzahl von Kund en , Anbietern und Technologien zu haben. Unser Geschäftsbereich wächst schnell und es gibt viele Möglichkeiten, deine Karriere selbst zu definieren.

Wir helfen dir, dich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln: durch unsere Schulungen, Mentoring-Programme und On- the -Job-Lernen, aber auch durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Partnern aus verschiedenen Branchen.

Arbeiten bei Deloitte

Bei Deloitte zeigen deine Ideen Wirkung und lösen bedeutende Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft aus. Dein Fachwissen, deine Erfahrung und deine Perspektive helfen uns, neue Wege für die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, damit wir die Zukunft all derer verbessern können, auf die unsere Arbeit einen Einfluss hat. Bei Deloitte kannst du eine Karriere aufbauen, die dich inspiriert und jeden Tag aufs Neue motiviert. Bei Deloitte " you can choose your impact ".

In der Schweiz erbringen wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation . Mit mehr als 3.000 Mitarbeitern an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Grösse in allen Branchen. Support development of A/B tests related to buyer and seller trust, behavior, and inventory velocity

Work cross-functionally with peer analytics partners to develop comprehensive tools and business recommendations

Able to build constructive and effective relationships with a broad and diverse group of business partners
Track record of presenting ideas and directions to influence others into taking desired actions

Title: Reference Data Specialist
Description:
Company Description

Vitol is an energy and commodities company with revenues of $331 billion in 2024; its primary business is the trading and distribution of energy products globally – it trades over seven million barrels per day of crude oil and products and, at any time, has 250 ships transporting its cargoes.

Vitol’s clients include national oil companies, multinationals, leading industrial companies and utilities. Founded in Rotterdam in 1966, today Vitol serves clients from some 40 offices worldwide and is invested in energy assets globally including 24mM3 of storage, 850kbpd of refining capacity, and 10,000 service stations. To date, we have committed over $2.5 billion of capital to renewable projects and are identifying and developing low-carbon opportunities around the world.

Job Description

The Reference Data Specialist will manage Vitol’s reference data across multiple systems, ensuring datasets are accurate, consistent and fit for use across applications and business processes.

Role responsibilities will span three adjacent areas:


Supporting system migrations and dataset harmonisation
Provide cross-application mappings to unify datasets and manage application-specific edge cases.
Clean, validate and prepare datasets before Master Data onboarding.
Map data lineage and perform non-regression checks to protect existing application functionality.
Design and run automated tests to support application onboarding and migration activities.
Ensuring reference data quality through monitoring and review
Own Master Data-hosted reference datasets and resolve day-to-day support tickets promptly.
Define validation rules and data quality controls across key datasets.
Implement monitoring tools, exception reports and corrective actions.
Identify recurring data issues and propose improvements to prevent reoccurrence.
Acting as the first point of contact for users and application owners
Serve as a trusted partner for users, application owners and project teams on reference data matters.
Triage and resolve support requests, clarifying requirements and coordinating fixes where needed.
Support teams deploying Master Data into new or existing solutions.
Provide guidance on data consumption, mappings and onboarding standards.


Qualifications


2+ years’ experience working with C# and related .NET technologies, preferably ASP.NET Core.
Demonstrated ownership and responsiveness in a fast-paced environment.
Proven experience in data management, with strong attention to detail.
Ability to understand interlinked dependencies across systems and datasets.
Ability to audit codebases including SQL, .NET, React and Python.
Ability to develop and run non-regression and monitoring scripts in Python.
Experience with CTRM systems and commodity trading workflows is a plus but not required.


Additional Information

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to work across both business and technology teams. The candidate should be comfortable investigating data issues, understanding dependencies across systems, and translating business requirements into practical data management solutions.

Relevant experience may include:


Reference data, master data or data governance experience.
Experience supporting system migrations, application onboarding or data integration projects.
Strong understanding of data quality principles and control frameworks.
Ability to analyse datasets, identify inconsistencies and define remediation actions.
Experience working with ticketing systems and production support processes.
Familiarity with data mapping, lineage documentation and automated testing.
Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, structured and detail-oriented approach to problem solving.

Title: Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence 80-100% (m/f/d)
Description:
Switzerland, Visp

Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed

Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly in Operations, we build production-ready data infrastructure that connects process, execution, and development data into a coherent and trusted foundation used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Operations, and global data teams.

We are looking for a Data Engineer – Process Analytics & Data Intelligence in Visp to design, build, and operate this data foundation and support reliable, scalable use of operational data across teams

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What You’ll Get


An agile career and dynamic working culture.
An inclusive and ethical workplace.
Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597


What You Will Do:


Design, build, and operate automated data pipelines integrating distributed file-based data stores and raw operational system databases, including historians (PI), MES, ELN and instrument data, into a coherent, end-to-end operational data foundation.
Replace manual, file-based data handling with governed, versioned and traceable data flows that stand up to daily operational use.
Implement and enforce data quality checks, validation rules and monitoring to ensure data reliability at scale in an operational environment.
Deliver analytics-ready datasets (clean schemas, consistent semantics, time-aligned data) to downstream BI, advanced analytics and modeling layers supporting operational decision-making.
Work closely with MSAT, Process Development, Automation, QA, IT and global data teams to align data models, definitions and integration patterns across the organization.
Continuously improve pipeline performance, robustness and maintainability in line with operational priorities.


What we are looking for:


Proven experience building, operating, and optimizing production-grade data pipelines in manufacturing, industrial, or operational environments.
Strong SQL expertise with the ability to design efficient data models and optimize queries for high-volume operational workloads.
Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipeline development and integration of process, execution, and operational data sources.
Practical knowledge of OT systems, including MES, PI Historian, instrument data, or similar industrial data platforms.
Solid understanding of data quality, lineage, traceability, governance, and compliance, ideally within GxP-regulated environments.
Experience with Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake/Blob Storage, Git-based version control, and cloud-native data architectures.
Background in biopharma, life sciences, manufacturing, or operations data, with the ability to translate complex operational processes into scalable data solutions.


About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Title: Corporate Real Estate Analyst
Description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data analyses, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that property decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights.

The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, creating dashboards in Power BI, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders.

We offer flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with time spent in the office.

How You’ll Make An Impact


Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information
Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team
Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users
Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner
Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data
Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control
Raise purchase orders and verify invoices
Prepare presentation materials, data analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools
Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting
Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division’s intranet presence
Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities


Your background


Proven experience in real estate data management, data analytics, and reporting
Experience in lease management
Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function
Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data
Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform
Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset
Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving
Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment



More About Us

Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams.

The minimum salary for this position in the location (Italy) specified:


Starting from: 44,800 € gross annual salary
Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico


The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role is open in France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.

Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:


Competitive salary and incentives

Flexible work options
Benefits that support your financial security

Title: Manager Supply Chain Business Intelligence (Power BI / SQL) (m/f/d)
Description:
Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

Are you enthusiastic about the prospect of driving excellence in reporting & analytics capabilities to increase transparency and visibility across the entire supply chain organization? Do you enjoy using SQL to answer critical business questions and to deliver insights that drive decision-making? If you have strong front-end visualization experience and want to make a meaningful impact on the adidas supply chain, this role offers a great opportunity to do so. The role of Manager SC Business Intelligence is tailor-made for you!

As part of the Supply Chain Intelligence team, we are actively seeking an experienced Manager of Supply Chain Business Intelligence to build and enhance reporting capabilities, ensuring standardization, harmonization, and scalability. Your role will be instrumental in creating visibility to increase the proactive management of our business operations. Join us in shaping the future of supply chain excellence at adidas.

Key Responsibilities


Develop scalable reporting solutions and visualize data using BI tools such as Power BI.
Utilize SQL queries to extract, transform and load data – while securing one version of truth by actively standardizing, harmonizing data.
Translate business requirements into technical specifications for the Data Transformation team (e.g. data points, architecture, and models).
Ensure that relevant metrics are timely developed, validated across markets and documented to bring transparency. Generate detailed and up-to-date documentation in Confluence.
Manage the deployment of the reporting capabilities including optimizing dashboard performance, conducting thorough data validation, and onboarding the Supply Chain reporting user community.
Coordinate and actively contribute to user acceptance testing and change management for newly developed reporting capabilities, ensuring successful rollout and adoption across SCM Markets and key stakeholders.
Run root cause analysis to support business in answering key management questions.


Key Relationships

Stakeholders can relate to the following core functions:


SCM - Global / Market Functions (e.g. Digital Process Management)
SCM - Strategy & Digital Solutions (e.g., Strategy & Transformation, Product owners)
Global DNA, Global TECH, and external developers


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


BI Expertise: Develop and maintain insightful dashboards and self-service reports using Power BI. Strong skills in DAX, data modeling, and report performance optimization. Use advanced tools to accelerate report performance (e.g. DAX Studio, Tabular Editor).
Data Proficiency: Manage the end-to-end process of gathering, extracting, and transforming data across sources using relevant tools (e.g. SQL, Python). Ensure data quality and harmonization to empower other teams.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills. Able to identify root causes, spot patterns, and translate into actionable recommendations.
Operational Insight: Understands KPIs, operational processes, and the trade-offs needed to balance speed and accuracy.
Communication: Confident presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences to deliver insights and project updates.
Collaborative Style: Ability to work collaboratively across teams to support user acceptance testing, data validation, and user education for new reporting capabilities, engaging stakeholders at all levels.
Growth Mindset: Embraces feedback and setbacks as learning opportunities. Constantly seeks to improve tools, processes, and self.


Requisite Education And Qualifications


Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in reporting and analytics, including front-end visualization and tools such as SQL and Python.
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Planning or Information Systems from an accredited institution.
Proven experience in business intelligence role with strong understanding of business intelligence concepts, tools (e.g. Power BI and SQL), and methodologies.
Good understanding of supply chain principles and operating practices, logistics terminology, basic finance, and management of cross functional interdependencies.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)*
Description:
Über uns

Die Gesundheit der Menschen ist wichtig. SCHOTT Pharma entwickelt Lösungen, die weltweit sichere und einfach anzuwendende Medikamente gewährleisten. Ein Team von 4.700 Mitarbeitern aus über 60 Nationen trägt zur globalen Gesundheitsversorgung bei. Mit 17 Standorten weltweit ist das Unternehmen in Mainz ansässig, an der Frankfurter Börse gelistet und engagiert sich für nachhaltige Entwicklung.

Ihre Aufgaben


Sie analysieren Maschinen- und Prozessdaten zur Verbesserung von Ausbeute (Yield), Prozessstabilität und Qualität
Sie unterstützen datengetrieben bei der Analyse von Prozess- und Qualitätsabweichungen (Root-Cause-Analysen)
Sie begleiten Entwicklungsprojekte mit Statistik, Modellierung und Szenarioanalysen
Sie leisten datengetriebene Beiträge zu Energieoptimierung und CO2-Reduktion
Sie bauen anwendungsnahe KI-Agenten inklusive Tools und Skills und entwickeln Machine-Learning-Modelle für konkrete industrielle Use Cases
Sie präsentieren Ihre Analysen überzeugend und schaffen die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen im Management und in den Fachbereichen

Title: Senior Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics
Description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

The Opportunity

The position works out of our Basel, Switzerland location at the global Headquarters of our medicines business. Our medicines business (Established Pharmaceuticals) is committed to bringing the benefits of our trusted medicines to more people in the world’s fastest-growing countries. Our broad portfolio of high-quality and differentiated branded generic medicines reaches across multiple therapeutic areas including gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic, pain management/central nervous system, and respiratory.

As Senior HR Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics, you’ll have the chance to work with our global enterprise People Analytics team across multiple countries and regions. In this high-impact role, you will transform workforce data into actionable insights that help leaders make smarter talent and organizational decisions.

Working closely with HR leaders, HR Directors, HR Business Partners, and business stakeholders, you will combine advanced analytics, data storytelling, and consultative problem-solving to drive workforce strategy and business outcomes.

What You'll Do


Deliver data-driven workforce insights across key people metrics, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations that inform strategic decision-making
Design and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Power BI, and cloud-based platforms
Apply statistical and predictive analytics using Python and/or R to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Partner with senior HR leadership (Divisional Vice Presidents, Senior HR Directors) to solve workforce challenges through data-driven decision-making
Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools (e.g., Copilot, Generative AI and automated analytics platforms) to improve efficiency and speed to insight
Incorporate external benchmarks and labor market insights to contextualize workforce analytics findings
Connect analytical outputs to strategic workforce priorities such as workforce planning, Scenario modelling, and HR investment decisions


Qualifications


5+ years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related HR Domain field
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Psychology, or related field; master’s degree preferred
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets in cloud environments
Proficiency in Python and/or R for analytics and statistical modeling
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools
Experience applying statistical methods such as regression, predictive modeling, or classification techniques in workforce contexts
Demonstrated experience interfacing with and influencing senior HR leadership (Senior Directors, Divisional Vice Presidents), with a high degree of professionalism, business acumen, and executive communication capability.
Fluent English


Why Join Abbott?


Career development with an international company where you can grow your career
Build a unique combination of technical, consulting, and strategic leadership capabilities
A challenging position where you can influence enterprise workforce and talent decisions on a global scale


Bring your analytical expertise, business curiosity, and passion for data-driven decision-making to help Abbott create a healthier future for people around the world. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

We ask for your understanding that we only consider online applications via our online application portal. Applications by email or post cannot be processed. Original documents will not be returned.

As Senior Regulatory Data Analyst (reporting to the Registration & Compliance Lead, Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE), you will work within our Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE – Registration & compliance, you will provide subject matter expertise with chemical regulatory compliance, chemical management and be responsible for by carrying out compliance monitoring reviews to ensure the business is meeting its regulatory obligations and risks are mitigated.

In this role, you will develop, implement and maintain processes, programs to ensure compliance with existing and emerging chemical control legislations.

Sounds interesting? It could well be your perfect opportunity if, like us, you always aim to exceed customer needs, deliver value and are skilled at fostering strong relationships.

In This Exciting Role You Will


Perform compliance monitoring on all aspects of the CCL (Chemical Control Legislation) to assess compliance with applicable regulations, standards and outcomes.
Collaborate with the RAPS team and business stakeholders to finalise reports for presentation and submission to relevant boards and sub-committees, in line with the requirements of the plan, including impact analysis for decision making.
Provide analyses for large datasets necessary for decisions using actionable insights
Attending sub-committee’s sessions as required to present monitoring findings and recommendations.
Support the review/update/development of the regulatory/compliance policies and procedures to ensure they remain appropriate, relevant and effective.
Participate to the development of the solutions to ensure of the compliance globally, the testing and the training of the teams as needed
Define and deliver metrics, reporting platforms, dashboards for tracking and managing the compliance
Tracking of monitoring actions through to successful resolution
Identify business challenges and initiate process improvement projects
Facilitate the computerization of analytics and data collection processes


You?

Are you someone who wants to grow and shape your own world? Who thrives being in a culture where you can express yourself in a creative team environment? Who wants to collaborate and learn together with teams who are as passionate as you are? Then come join us – and impact your world.

A minimum of 5 years relevant in a compliance role in chemical or related industry
Proficient knowledge of BI, SAP, or other business Intelligence tools. Must also demonstrate advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Familiarity with programming languages (e.g: Python, Javascript, SQL) and AI is a plus
Strong analytical skills
Good working knowledge of CCL regulatory requirements and legal guidelines is an advantage
Business fluency in English AND French is a must
Experience in supporting cross functional groups and teams
Ability to work well in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment


Our Benefits

Retirement plan
Sport and leisure clubs
Company shop
Staff restaurant
Corporate Mobility Plan
