Title: Data Scientist, Marketing Analytics
Description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:


SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.


Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:


Committed to our customers and community.
Obsessed with quality.
Deliberate in our decisions.
Effective as one team.


With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position Description

This role is the data team's dedicated analytical partner for Marketing. Your core job is to turn marketing data into decisions: diagnose what is working and what is not, explain why, and recommend where to spend the next dollar. You will own marketing attribution, ROI, and conversion analysis end to end, and you will be proactive about it, surfacing findings and opportunities before anyone asks.

You will explore data, form hypotheses, and partner with our Data and Analytics Engineers to shape the models and pipelines you need. You will help define those models, but your primary measure of success is the quality and impact of your analysis.

This role sits in the Data & Insights team and partners closely with Marketing, IT/Marketing Ops, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and data scientists covering other domains.

What You Will Do


Drive marketing decisions with analysis. Own attribution, ROI, conversion, and funnel analysis. Diagnose drops and anomalies, quantify what drives them, and translate findings into clear recommendations for marketing leaders.
Optimize marketing spend. Connect spend to outcomes across channels and campaigns, and advise on where to invest, cut, or test next.
Be proactive. Explore and correlate data to surface insights nobody asked for. Anticipate the next question. Bring opportunities to the marketing team rather than waiting for requests.
Run experiments. Design and read out A/B tests and other experiments, applying sound statistical methods and being honest about significance and causality.
Partner on the data foundation. Work hand in hand with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to get marketing data into the warehouse and modeled. Define requirements, explore raw data, and contribute to data models that connect marketing data with sales and product data.
Tell the story. Communicate insights so non-technical stakeholders can act, and document context, caveats, and decisions so the work survives handoffs.


Experience And Qualifications


Strong analytical track record: someone who has measurably influenced business or marketing decisions through analysis, not just produced reports.
Comfort with the latest AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and sharper: exploring data, writing and debugging code, drafting analysis, and accelerating insight. You stay current as the tooling evolves and bring new approaches to the team.
Eagerness to develop: you actively grow your skills, seek feedback, and treat new tools and methods as opportunities rather than threats.
Solid SQL. You can independently query, join, and explore data without waiting for someone to prepare it for you.
Proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation.
Statistical foundation: experimentation, significance testing, regression, segmentation, forecasting, and the judgment to know which applies.
Working knowledge of marketing and GTM data: channels, campaigns, attribution models, funnel and conversion metrics, and the realities of joining marketing data to CRM/sales and product usage data.
Willingness to get hands-on with data modeling. You don't need to be a dbt expert, but you must be comfortable exploring messy data and partnering on (or building) the models you need rather than waiting for clean tables.
Strong communication and stakeholder skills: you can challenge weak measurement respectfully and make a recommendation, not just present options.
Proactivity and autonomy: you raise your hand early, plan your own work, and look for impact without being asked.


In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at [email protected] .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position Description

This role is the data team's dedicated analytical partner for Marketing. Your core job is to turn marketing data into decisions: diagnose what is working and what is not, explain why, and recommend where to spend the next dollar. You will own marketing attribution, ROI, and conversion analysis end to end, and you will be proactive about it, surfacing findings and opportunities before anyone asks.

You will explore data, form hypotheses, and partner with our Data and Analytics Engineers to shape the models and pipelines you need. You will help define those models, but your primary measure of success is the quality and impact of your analysis.

This role sits in the Data & Insights team and partners closely with Marketing, IT/Marketing Ops, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and data scientists covering other domains.

What You Will Do

  • Drive marketing decisions with analysis. Own attribution, ROI, conversion, and funnel analysis. Diagnose drops and anomalies, quantify what drives them, and translate findings into clear recommendations for marketing leaders.
  • Optimize marketing spend. Connect spend to outcomes across channels and campaigns, and advise on where to invest, cut, or test next.
  • Be proactive. Explore and correlate data to surface insights nobody asked for. Anticipate the next question. Bring opportunities to the marketing team rather than waiting for requests.
  • Run experiments. Design and read out A/B tests and other experiments, applying sound statistical methods and being honest about significance and causality.
  • Partner on the data foundation. Work hand in hand with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to get marketing data into the warehouse and modeled. Define requirements, explore raw data, and contribute to data models that connect marketing data with sales and product data.
  • Tell the story. Communicate insights so non-technical stakeholders can act, and document context, caveats, and decisions so the work survives handoffs.

Experience And Qualifications

  • Strong analytical track record: someone who has measurably influenced business or marketing decisions through analysis, not just produced reports.
  • Comfort with the latest AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and sharper: exploring data, writing and debugging code, drafting analysis, and accelerating insight. You stay current as the tooling evolves and bring new approaches to the team.
  • Eagerness to develop: you actively grow your skills, seek feedback, and treat new tools and methods as opportunities rather than threats.
  • Solid SQL. You can independently query, join, and explore data without waiting for someone to prepare it for you.
  • Proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation.
  • Statistical foundation: experimentation, significance testing, regression, segmentation, forecasting, and the judgment to know which applies.
  • Working knowledge of marketing and GTM data: channels, campaigns, attribution models, funnel and conversion metrics, and the realities of joining marketing data to CRM/sales and product usage data.
  • Willingness to get hands-on with data modeling. You don't need to be a dbt expert, but you must be comfortable exploring messy data and partnering on (or building) the models you need rather than waiting for clean tables.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills: you can challenge weak measurement respectfully and make a recommendation, not just present options.
  • Proactivity and autonomy: you raise your hand early, plan your own work, and look for impact without being asked.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. IT Business Analyst - Data Warehouse (w/m/d)

Du willst dich entfalten? Wir geben dir den Raum dazu.

Gestalte mit uns die datengetriebene Zukunft von PostFinance. Auf unserer analytischen Plattform integrieren wir unternehmensweit Daten und stellen diese für Reporting, Analytics und Data-Science-Anwendungen bereit. Als IT Business Analyst bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und IT: Du analysierst Anforderungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Teams nachhaltige Lösungen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer analytischen Plattform bei. Mit deinem Verständnis für Daten, Prozesse und Technologien schaffst du echten Mehrwert für das Business und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur datengetriebenen Transformation von PostFinance. Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlage für fundierte Entscheidungen, innovative Services und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg.

Bern / Homeoffice

unbefristet

Du gestaltest und entwickelst gemeinsam mit einem agilen Team die analytische Plattform von PostFinance weiter und trägst so aktiv zu ihrer Zukunftsfähigkeit bei
Du analysierst Anforderungen mit deinem fundierten Verständnis von Daten und Geschäftsprozessen und übersetzt diese in technische Konzepte, durchdachte Lösungsdesigns und aussagekräftige Datenvisualisierungen
Du erstellst und pflegst eine nachhaltige und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation komplexer Software-Artefakte und Datenmodelle. Dazu gehören Prozess- und Ablaufdiagramme, technische Dokumentationen sowie Schnittstellenbeschreibungen
Du bringst eine lösungsorientierte und kollegiale Arbeitsweise mit, hinterfragst Bestehendes und entwickelst tragfähige sowie zukunftsgerichtete Lösungen. Dabei setzt du deine Ideen erfolgreich in die Praxis um und schaffst nachhaltigen Mehrwert

Tertiärer Abschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet (FH/Uni) oder eine vergleichbare Weiterbildung mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Requirements Engineering, in der Datenanalyse und Datenmodellierung innerhalb komplexer Data-Warehouse-Landschaften sowie vertiefte Kenntnisse von Oracle-Technologien im Banking- oder Zahlungsverkehrsumfeld
Erfahrung mit grossen Datenmengen, fortgeschrittene SQL-Kenntnisse sowie Interesse für die fachlichen und technischen Aspekte von Daten
Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem ausgeprägten Qualitätsbewusstsein
Ausgeprägter Teamgeist, hohe Eigeninitiative und eine pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität mit Freude daran, Lösungen gemeinsam voranzutreiben
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Title: Senior Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics
Description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

The Opportunity

The position works out of our Basel, Switzerland location at the global Headquarters of our medicines business. Our medicines business (Established Pharmaceuticals) is committed to bringing the benefits of our trusted medicines to more people in the world’s fastest-growing countries. Our broad portfolio of high-quality and differentiated branded generic medicines reaches across multiple therapeutic areas including gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic, pain management/central nervous system, and respiratory.

As Senior HR Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics, you’ll have the chance to work with our global enterprise People Analytics team across multiple countries and regions. In this high-impact role, you will transform workforce data into actionable insights that help leaders make smarter talent and organizational decisions.

Working closely with HR leaders, HR Directors, HR Business Partners, and business stakeholders, you will combine advanced analytics, data storytelling, and consultative problem-solving to drive workforce strategy and business outcomes.

What You'll Do


Deliver data-driven workforce insights across key people metrics, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations that inform strategic decision-making
Design and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Power BI, and cloud-based platforms
Apply statistical and predictive analytics using Python and/or R to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Partner with senior HR leadership (Divisional Vice Presidents, Senior HR Directors) to solve workforce challenges through data-driven decision-making
Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools (e.g., Copilot, Generative AI and automated analytics platforms) to improve efficiency and speed to insight
Incorporate external benchmarks and labor market insights to contextualize workforce analytics findings
Connect analytical outputs to strategic workforce priorities such as workforce planning, Scenario modelling, and HR investment decisions


Qualifications


5+ years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related HR Domain field
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Psychology, or related field; master’s degree preferred
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets in cloud environments
Proficiency in Python and/or R for analytics and statistical modeling
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools
Experience applying statistical methods such as regression, predictive modeling, or classification techniques in workforce contexts
Demonstrated experience interfacing with and influencing senior HR leadership (Senior Directors, Divisional Vice Presidents), with a high degree of professionalism, business acumen, and executive communication capability.
Fluent English


Why Join Abbott?


Career development with an international company where you can grow your career
Build a unique combination of technical, consulting, and strategic leadership capabilities
A challenging position where you can influence enterprise workforce and talent decisions on a global scale


Bring your analytical expertise, business curiosity, and passion for data-driven decision-making to help Abbott create a healthier future for people around the world. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Title: Senior Reporting Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Location: Zurich, Switzerland (Hybrid)

In this position, you’ll be based in the Zurich office for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex .

We give you a world of potential

Join Computershare (ASX: CPU), a global market leader renowned for its expertise and scale across diverse financial and governance services. Since our founding in 1978, we've built a reputation for high-integrity data management, high-volume transaction processing, and exceptional stakeholder engagement.

Our core services include transfer agency and share registration, employee equity plans, proxy solicitation, and stakeholder communications, alongside specializations in corporate trust, mortgage, bankruptcy, class action, and utility administration. Many of the world’s leading organizations trust us to streamline and maximize the value of their relationships with their investors, employees, creditors, and customers; and you can be a vital part of that success.

A role you will love

Client Asset Management (CAM) is the department within Equatex AG (Computershare) responsible for the monitoring and control of client cash movements and securities transactions. The Reporting Analyst is part of a specialized team supporting the reconciliation environment used to ensure the accuracy and integrity of client asset records.

Working closely with a Senior Technology Contractor based in Zurich, the Reporting Analyst is responsible for maintaining the Clareti Transaction Control (CTC) reconciliation platform, supporting reconciliation operators through accurate data processing, system configuration, reporting, and operational analysis. The role has a direct reporting line into the Chief Financial Officer, Equatex AG.

The Reporting Analyst will also work closely with the Global Reconciliation System team to support the global reconciliation platform, Accurate and for this reason will have a functional reporting line into the Head of Global Reconciliation and Systems based in Bristol.

The role requires collaboration across operational and technology teams and plays a key part in ensuring critical daily processes are completed accurately and within strict timeframes.

Key Responsibilities Include


Maintain and monitor the CTC reconciliation platform, ensuring system availability, responsiveness, and operational readiness during Swiss and UK business hours.
Manage internal and external data feeds, ensuring data is received, loaded, and processed accurately within agreed deadlines.
Monitor data quality within CTC and investigate operational anomalies to ensure information is complete, accurate, and fit for purpose.
Assist with the maintenance and monitoring of the global Accurate reconciliation platform.
Configure and maintain reconciliation rules, system parameters, and reporting outputs to support ongoing business and operational requirements.
Build, maintain, and enhance reports used by reconciliation operators and stakeholders to support daily operations and decision-making.
Identify, analyse, and resolve reconciliation issues, including payment rejections, returns, and data discrepancies.
Collaborate with internal teams, external providers, and stakeholders to resolve data delivery issues and support continuous process improvements.
Contribute to projects, system enhancements, and operational improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and control within the reconciliation environment.


What will you bring to the role?

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical professional who enjoys working with financial data, systems, and operational processes. The ideal candidate combines strong technical aptitude with problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a controlled and time-sensitive environment. They are highly organised, proactive, and capable of building effective working relationships across teams while maintaining a strong focus on accuracy and service quality.


Relevant experience in financial services, banking operations, reconciliation, reporting, or a similar operational environment.
Experience working with data analysis, reporting tools, reconciliation platforms, or financial operational systems, with a strong knowledge of SQL queries and commands, ETL processes, feeds and jobs and Microsoft SSIS.
Some knowledge of Linux tools, XML / CSV and data warehouses is also required with experience in Oracle PL/SQL, Excel, Swift standards also an advantage.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate anomalies and identify root causes.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to operational deadlines.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high standards of data quality and control.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with operational teams, technology specialists, and external stakeholders.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives and process improvements.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where daily operational deadlines and regulatory controls are critical.
Strong English communication skills; German language skills are an advantage.


Rewards designed for you

Global opportunities. Everyone here has the opportunity to grow through on-the-job training, access to comprehensive learning resources and career development support.

Invest in our business by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you’ll receive a company contribution as well.

Health and wellbeing rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family including accident insurance and income protection.

Save for your future. We will support you along your retirement savings journey.

Extra rewards ranging from recognition awards to transport and child allowances.

And more. Ours is a welcoming and close-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub.

About Us

We’re experts in managing compensation plans for global businesses. We partner with some of the world’s leading companies, delivering employee incentive schemes across borders, languages, and currencies.

Equatex is part of the Computershare group, a world leader in financial administration with over 11,000 employees across 22 different countries. At Computershare, it’s more than just a job, our open and inclusive culture means that we will help you to grow, to move forward and make the most of the world of opportunities we have available. With infinite possibilities, we could take you anywhere.

About The Team

We’re a leading provider of employee share plans. We partner with many of the world’s biggest brands to offer their employees the chance to invest in the future of their company and help them to manage these investments day to day. With over 35 years of experience and expertise, we’re an industry leader. Every member of our team plays an important role in bringing to life employee share plans, providing innovative solutions and assisting our clients with their complex regulatory requirements.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to bring real transparency to how our product and marketing efforts are performing. You'll build the reporting that shows what's actually happening across the customer journey, and help the team understand whether new features and initiatives are delivering what they promised.




This is a remote role. Most of the team is based in Switzerland, so we're looking for meaningful overlap with Central European working hours and comfort working in English, our team's working language.


Tasks


What You'll Do





Build and maintain dashboards and reporting across the full customer journey, covering acquisition, activation, conversion, engagement, retention, transactions, and drop-off points


Define KPI definitions, calculation methodology, ownership, and reporting frequency, and work with Technology to keep the underlying tracking solid


Monitor product, marketing, and funnel KPIs on an ongoing basis, and flag unusual trends, risks, and performance gaps early, with context on likely causes


Distinguish short-term fluctuations from structural issues, and run regular performance reviews with Product, Marketing, Technology, and leadership


Connect product and marketing KPIs to broader business objectives such as GMV, active users, conversion, and retention, and help leadership prioritise where to focus


Define success metrics, baselines, and evaluation periods before new features and initiatives launch


Track adoption, usage, and business impact after launch, and give a clear, evidence-based read on whether an initiative delivered


Turn analysis into practical, prioritised recommendations for Product, Marketing, and Technology


Help teams design experiments and determine how their impact should be measured





Who You'll Work With




You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Product Management day to day. You'll also partner regularly with the Head of Marketing and the Marketing team, and the Head of Technology and the Technology team, keeping Operations and leadership in the loop on your insights and recommendations.


Requirements


What You'll Need





Several years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or business intelligence, ideally at a digital product, marketplace, fintech, or platform business


A track record of building dashboards, defining KPIs, and measuring the impact of features and campaigns


Strong command of funnel, cohort, retention, and segmentation analysis


Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase, and product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Google Analytics


Good SQL skills, so you can pull and analyse your own data independently


Ability to turn data into a clear business recommendation, and a solid grasp of what drives the business, including GMV, activation, conversion, retention, and LTV


Confidence to challenge assumptions when the data tells a different story


Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical stakeholders


A proactive, structured, and independent way of working, comfortable operating with incomplete data and shifting priorities





Nice to Have





Experience with A/B testing and statistical evaluation


Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery


Familiarity with using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analytical work



Benefits


What We Offer





High visibility with leadership, your analysis and recommendations feed directly into real business decisions


Cross-functional exposure from day one, working closely with Product, Marketing, and Technology


Real ownership over how performance reporting and analytics get built at the company


Remote flexibility, with a closely connected, Switzerland-based core team





Scope of the Role




This role owns reporting transparency, KPI definitions, performance analysis, impact measurement, and recommendations. It is not accountable for implementing fixes: product delivery, campaign execution, technology implementation, and operational changes remain with the relevant functional leads.




If you enjoy turning data into clarity and want a role where your analysis genuinely shapes decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Requirements

  • High visibility with leadership, your analysis and recommendations feed directly into real business decisions

  • Real ownership over how performance reporting and analytics get built at the company

  • Remote flexibility, with a closely connected, Switzerland-based core team

This role owns reporting transparency, KPI definitions, performance analysis, impact measurement, and recommendations. It is not accountable for implementing fixes: product delivery, campaign execution, technology implementation, and operational changes remain with the relevant functional leads.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Nuova opportunità in AXA Partners Italy.

Unisciti a noi come Data Analyst e diventa una figura chiave nel nostro team IT, Data & AI di Roma. In questo ruolo dinamico avrai la straordinaria opportunità di trasformare dati complessi in insight fruibili, guidando decisioni strategiche e promuovendo l'innovazione in AXA Partners.

Cosa Farai

La tua missione sarà trasformare i dati in valore per il business, guidando l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science. Sarai responsabile della progettazione e dell'evoluzione di dashboard e reportistica avanzata, della generazione di insight strategici e dell'applicazione di tecniche analitiche evolute, incluse Machine Learning, modellazione predittiva e analisi delle serie temporali.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder nazionali e internazionali, comprendendone esigenze e obiettivi per tradurli in soluzioni data-driven ad alto impatto. Attraverso un'efficace combinazione di data visualization, storytelling e competenze analitiche, supporterai il processo decisionale, contribuendo concretamente alla crescita della cultura del dato e all'innovazione all'interno di AXA Partners.

Sarai Al Centro Della Nostra Strategia Dati, Contribuendo a

Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere dashboard, reportistica avanzata e analisi ad hoc, trasformando i dati in insight strategici a supporto dei processi decisionali aziendali.

Realizzare analisi approfondite sfruttando datamart, cubi analitici e fonti dati eterogenee, valorizzando tecniche di data visualization e data storytelling per favorire la comprensione e l'adozione degli insight.

Garantire l'affidabilità, la coerenza e la qualità dei dati attraverso attività di monitoraggio, validazione e gestione proattiva degli incidenti relativi agli strumenti e ai processi analitici.

Definire, implementare e promuovere standard metodologici, framework analitici e best practice per migliorare l'efficacia e la scalabilità delle soluzioni di analytics.

Contribuire alla diffusione di una cultura data-driven, condividendo competenze, supportando i team aziendali nell'interpretazione dei dati e favorendo l'adozione di approcci basati su evidenze quantitative.

Partecipare attivamente alle community e alle guild di Data & AI Analytics, contribuendo all'innovazione continua, alla sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie e alla crescita delle competenze interne.

Collaborare con stakeholder di business e team multidisciplinari lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle iniziative data-driven, dall'identificazione delle esigenze fino al rilascio delle soluzioni analitiche e predittive.

Applicare tecniche avanzate di Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e analisi delle serie temporali per sviluppare modelli in grado di generare valore e supportare decisioni strategiche.

Industrializzare, distribuire e monitorare modelli e algoritmi in ambiente di produzione, garantendone performance, affidabilità e miglioramento continuo nel tempo.

Facilitare workshop e momenti di confronto interfunzionale, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in raccomandazioni chiare e actionable per interlocutori non tecnici.

Sviluppare una profonda conoscenza del patrimonio informativo aziendale e dei processi di business, identificando opportunità di innovazione e assicurando l'integrazione efficace delle soluzioni dati all'interno dell'ecosistema AXA Partners.

Supportare la definizione di casi d'uso avanzati e la misurazione del valore generato dalle iniziative di Analytics e AI, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi strategici dell'organizzazione.

Cerchiamo Un/a Professionista Con

Esperienza e Formazione:


3-5+ anni di comprovata esperienza in un ruolo di Data Analyst, Data Scientist o simile ruolo quantitativo.
Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o Ingegneria.
Certificazioni preferenziali: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks (DP-750).


Competenze Tecniche Essenziali


Business Intelligence & Data Visualization: Elevata competenza nell'utilizzo di Power BI per la progettazione e lo sviluppo di dashboard interattive, reportistica avanzata e KPI framework. Solida esperienza nella modellazione dati, nell'ottimizzazione delle performance e nell'utilizzo di DAX per la costruzione di metriche complesse e analisi self-service orientate al business.
Data Science & Big Data Analytics: Esperienza pratica nell'utilizzo di Databricks per attività di data preparation, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering e sviluppo di modelli avanzati di Machine Learning su dataset di grandi dimensioni, sfruttando architetture distribuite e framework Big Data.
Cloud Data Platform & Data Engineering: Solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema dati Microsoft Azure, con esperienza nell'utilizzo di Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks e Unity Catalog per la gestione, l'orchestrazione, la governance e la valorizzazione del patrimonio informativo aziendale.
Programmazione e Advanced Analytics: Ottima padronanza di Python (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, Scikit-learn), Scala e R per attività di analisi dati, automazione, modellazione statistica, Machine Learning e sviluppo di soluzioni data-driven scalabili ed efficienti.
Database Management & SQL: Competenze avanzate in SQL per interrogazione, trasformazione e ottimizzazione dei dati, con esperienza nella progettazione di query complesse, data modeling e gestione di ambienti relazionali e analitici ad alte prestazioni.
Version Control & Collaborative Development: Familiarità con Git e con le principali pratiche di versioning, collaborazione e gestione del ciclo di sviluppo del codice, a supporto di workflow strutturati e processi di delivery affidabili.
Data Architecture & Governance: Conoscenza delle principali tematiche di data governance, data quality, metadata management e data lineage, garantendo affidabilità, tracciabilità e conformità dei dati lungo l'intero ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche.
End-to-End Analytics Delivery: Capacità di operare lungo l'intera catena del valore del dato, dalla raccolta e preparazione delle informazioni fino alla produzione di insight, dashboard e modelli predittivi, assicurando un approccio integrato tra Analytics, Data Engineering e Data Science.


Competenze Analitiche e Di Data Science


Modellazione Avanzata e Data Science: Solida preparazione statistica e consolidata esperienza nell'applicazione di tecniche di Machine Learning supervisionato e non supervisionato, incluse regressione, classificazione, clustering e segmentazione avanzata. Competenza nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi e nell'analisi di serie temporali, con particolare attenzione alla validazione, interpretabilità e generazione di valore per il business.
MLOps e Industrializzazione dei Modelli: Esperienza nell'implementazione e nella gestione del ciclo di vita delle soluzioni di Machine Learning, dalla prototipazione al rilascio in produzione. Conoscenza dei principi e delle pratiche MLOps, inclusi deployment, monitoraggio delle performance, gestione del drift dei modelli, automazione dei processi e manutenzione continua per garantire affidabilità, scalabilità e sostenibilità delle soluzioni AI.
Data Storytelling e Insight Communication: Comprovata capacità di trasformare analisi complesse e risultati quantitativi in insight chiari, significativi e orientati all'azione. Abilità nel combinare data visualization, storytelling e comprensione del contesto di business per supportare il processo decisionale e massimizzare l'impatto delle iniziative di Analytics e Data Science sugli stakeholder


Soft Skills


Comunicazione e Collaborazione: Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) e italiano (madrelingua), con comprovata abilità nel tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in messaggi chiari e orientati al business. Forte predisposizione alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari, internazionali e multiculturali, favorendo l'allineamento tra funzioni tecniche e stakeholder di business.
Adattabilità e Resilienza: Capacità di operare con efficacia in ambienti dinamici e in continua evoluzione, gestendo simultaneamente priorità multiple, scadenze sfidanti e cambiamenti organizzativi. Approccio resiliente e orientato ai risultati, mantenendo elevati standard qualitativi anche in contesti ad alta pressione.
Proattività e Problem Solving: Spiccata attitudine proattiva e forte orientamento al problem solving, con capacità di anticipare esigenze, identificare opportunità di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni innovative basate sui dati. Consolidata esperienza nella gestione delle relazioni con stakeholder a diversi livelli organizzativi, bilanciando aspettative, obiettivi di business e vincoli tecnici. Elevato grado di autonomia, accountability e orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati.
Pensiero Critico e Orientamento al Valore: Forte capacità analitica e di pensiero critico, con approccio strutturato alla risoluzione dei problemi e attenzione alla generazione di valore per il business attraverso insight data-driven e soluzioni innovative.


Cosa Offriamo

L'opportunità di entrare a far parte di un contesto internazionale, dinamico e orientato all'innovazione, dove il contributo individuale ha un impatto concreto sulle decisioni di business.

Un percorso di crescita professionale continuo, supportato da programmi di formazione, certificazioni, mentoring e confronto con professionisti del settore Data & AI.

La possibilità di lavorare su progetti strategici ad alto valore aggiunto, utilizzando tecnologie e piattaforme all'avanguardia nell'ambito Analytics, Cloud e Artificial Intelligence.

Un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione data-driven di AXA Partners, contribuendo alla definizione e all'evoluzione della strategia aziendale sui dati.

Un ambiente collaborativo e inclusivo, caratterizzato da forte contaminazione di competenze, con l'opportunità di interagire con team locali e internazionali.

Un pacchetto retributivo competitivo e coerente con l'esperienza, le competenze e il valore apportato alla funzione.

Un sistema di benefit e iniziative di welfare pensato per favorire il benessere, l'equilibrio vita-lavoro e lo sviluppo professionale delle persone.

Capacità di realizzare stored procedure e SQL function
MS Excel avanzato (VBA programming)
SAS Base/Guide, Python, R, Java, C++, Javascript/HTML, PHP

Crescita e Formazione

Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale.

Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration

Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro.

Salute & Benefits

Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati.

Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda.

Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).

La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.

L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting.

In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future.

Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati.

Famiglia e Genitorialità
 Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda.

Inclusione e Valori
 Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).

Next Steps

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.

Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca.

L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner.

L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting.

In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future.

Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente.

Cosa offriamo / What we offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato.

 L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda).

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.

Su di Noi

Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione.

Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi oltre 4500 professionisti, presenti in 13 Paesi, con oltre 4500
progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato.

Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a fare la differenza creando qualità su larga scala attraverso una formula che opera su tre leve: Valore, Persone e Tecnologia.

Crediamo nel valore dell’eccellenza, che è la bussola su cui orientiamo il nostro agire, e adottiamo un approccio etico e leale nei confronti di quante e quanti scelgono di lavorare con noi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui le persone possano crescere insieme, grazie alla contaminazione tra competenze diverse.

Title: Data Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Siamo una digital company che trasforma e migliora il modo in cui le aziende affrontano il mercato.

Dal 1981 diamo alle imprese la possibilità di accelerare il proprio sviluppo con un pensiero strategico, un approccio pratico e un ampio portafoglio di soluzioni innovative, grazie alle competenze in ambito Data Consulting, Big Data, Data Streaming, Internet of Things, Industry 4.0, Artificial Intelligence e Blockchain.

Non importa a che punto ti trovi del tuo viaggio. Entrando in Sogetel sarai protagonista di questo cambiamento digitale.

Posizione:

siamo alla ricerca di una figura con esperienza nell'elaborazione avanzata dei dati e nello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su modelli analitici. La risorsa contribuirà alla trasformazione dei dati in informazioni strategiche, supportando processi decisionali e lo sviluppo di prodotti e servizi data-driven.

Seniority 3-5 anni di esperienza, per attività presso importante azienda su sedi a ROMA e MILANO

Requisiti:

Requisiti


Esperienza nell'analisi quantitativa dei dati e nello sviluppo di modelli matematici e statistici.
Conoscenza delle principali tecniche di apprendimento automatico e dei relativi processi di addestramento e valutazione.
Familiarità con metodologie di preparazione, trasformazione e valorizzazione dei dati.
Capacità di definire criteri di misurazione delle performance e di interpretare i risultati dei modelli.
Conoscenza di strumenti e linguaggi per l'analisi dei dati e la realizzazione di soluzioni computazionali.
Solide basi in statistica, matematica applicata e analisi numerica.


Altre informazioni:

Modalità di lavoro: in sede su Roma o Milano, TEMPO INDETERMINATO, RAL in base all'esperienza, tra 30-35k circa, TEMPO DETERMINATO O P.IVA

Il presente annuncio è rivolto a tutti i soggetti senza forma di discriminazione alcuna. Chi fosse interessato può inviaci il proprio CV con autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi dell’art. 13 GDPR 679/16.

Title: Data Warehouse Specialist
Description:
Laser Romae è una PMI Innovativa che opera nel settore dell'Information and Communication Technology e dell'Ingegneria. Progettiamo e realizziamo soluzioni tecnologiche all'avanguardia per supportare la trasformazione digitale dei nostri clienti.

Il tuo ruolo nel team

Entrerai a far parte di un team tecnico affiatato e dinamico gestendo progetti di Data Analytics e Business Intelligence per i nostri clienti. Ti occuperai di progettare, implementare e ottimizzare l'architettura di Data Warehouse (DWH), sviluppare pipeline ETL automatizzate in Python e realizzare dashboard d'impatto ed efficienti con Power BI. Collaborando a stretto contatto con i referenti interni e i profili senior, avrai un ruolo chiave nell'estrazione del valore dai dati e nel supporto ai processi decisionali.

Responsabilità Principali


Progettare, sviluppare e manutenere l'architettura del Data Warehouse, definendo modelli di dati relazionali e dimensionali efficienti e scalabili.
Sviluppare e ottimizzare pipeline ETL/ELT e script automatizzati in Python per l'integrazione, la pulizia e la manipolazione di fonti dati eterogenee.
Progettare e mantenere report e dashboard interattive su Power BI, configurando modelli di dati complessi e logiche di calcolo avanzate in DAX e Power Query.
Garantire la Data Quality e l'integrità dei dati lungo tutto il ciclo di vita e la pipeline analytics.
Lavorare in sinergia con i team di Delivery, Architetti e Stakeholder aziendali/clienti per raccogliere requisiti di business e tradurli in specifiche tecniche e funzionali.


Requisiti Richiesti


Esperienza pregressa di almeno due anni in ruoli analoghi (DWH Engineer, Data Engineer, BI Specialist).
Ottima conoscenza dei concetti di Data Warehousing, modellazione dimensionale e padronanza avanzata del linguaggio SQL.
Solida conoscenza di Python per lo scripting, la gestione e la trasformazione di dataset.
Conoscenza approfondita di Power BI.
Buona conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione di basi di dati.
Capacità di analisi e problem solving strutturato per l'ottimizzazione delle query e delle performance dei report.


Sede di lavoro: Roma (ibrido)

Inquadramento: 32k - 35k

Prossimi step: colloquio conoscitivo, colloquio tecnico e proposta economico-contrattuale.

Aspettiamo la tua candidatura!

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03. Si raccomanda di allegare al CV l'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali come da D. Lgs N 196 del 30/06/2003 e del GDPR n. 679/2016.
